paper.title: Conservation Laws for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: While autoregressive models optimize the exact data likelihood via the chain rule, diffusion models are typically trained with denoising objectives. We develop conservation laws based on generalized extrinsic information transfer (GEXIT) functions for a broad class of memoryless noise processes, showing that the data--model cross-entropy (CE) can be characterized exactly as an integral of local information-theoretic derivatives along the noise path. This yields a unified characterization of the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再造一个 diffusion loss”，而是一个更基础的问题：对任意 memoryless noising path，diffusion 模型训练时用的局部去噪目标，究竟和数据分布上的全局 likelihood / cross-entropy 是什么精确关系。已有结果主要分裂在两端：连续高斯噪声有 I-MMSE 关系，离散 masked/noising 有各自的专门推导，但缺少一个统一框架来覆盖离散与连续 diffusion，也缺少对 mismatched setting 的刻画——也就是实际训练里 denoiser 不是精确后验，而是有限容量模型时，cross-entropy 如何由沿噪声路径的局部信息导数精确表示。论文给出的答案是一个 generalized GEXIT conservation law：数据-模型 cross-entropy 可以写成沿噪声轴积分的局部信息论导数，而且在 memoryless channel 下，这些导数只依赖边缘后验而不需要完整联合后验。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要有三层。第一层是理论统一：它把 discrete diffusion、Gaussian diffusion 以及更一般的 memoryless corruption 放进同一个 likelihood 视角里，说明 diffusion 并不是只能靠变分下界或启发式 denoising loss 来理解，而是可以像 AR 一样被放回“精确 cross-entropy 分解”的框架。第二层是训练目标层面的澄清：在最优条件下，学习问题可以还原成 token-level negative log-likelihood，且只需要边缘后验 P(X_i | Y(τ)) 或等价的 extrinsic posterior 结构，这对离散 diffusion LM 的目标设计、参数化和训练采样策略都有直接含义。第三层是实践层面的设计结论：当 denoiser 容量有限时，不同 noising channel 会诱导显著不同的有限容量误差，因此“选什么噪声路径”不再只是实现细节，而是和 tokenizer、模型容量、上下文建模难度同级的设计旋钮。这个结论对 text diffusion LM、masked LM、embedding diffusion，甚至 AR+diffusion 的联合建模都很关键。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文从一个很朴素但很有力的恒等式出发：沿着从 clean data 到 pure noise 的退化路径，条件熵 H(X|Y(τ)) 的增量望远镜求和后，得到总熵或更一般的 cross-entropy 的守恒关系。关键难点不在积分形式本身，而在于如何把 joint conditional entropy / CE 的导数，化成可训练、可解释的局部量。作者借用编码理论里的 EXIT / GEXIT 思路，证明在 memoryless channel 下，整体导数可以拆成各坐标的局部导数之和。进一步，在 mismatched setting 中，他们把真实数据分布 P 与模型后验 Q_θ 之间的数据-模型 cross-entropy 写成沿噪声参数 τ 的积分，积分核是局部信息导数项。这样一来，diffusion 的全局 CE 被精确连接到每个噪声级别上的局部去噪质量。

更具体地说，论文的几个技术点值得单独看。其一，统一性来自对“admissible memoryless channel”的抽象，而不是只对 Gaussian 或 masking 特判。Gaussian 情况退化到熟悉的 I-MMSE；离散情况则得到对应的 generalized EXIT 公式。其二，作者证明了 locality property：计算这些信息论导数时，不需要完整的联合后验 P(X|Y(τ))，只需边缘后验 P(X_i|Y(τ))，或者进一步写成 P(X_i|Y_{-i}(τ)) 再结合 channel tilt。这个结论很重要，因为完整联合后验在高维序列上几乎不可建模，而边缘后验更接近实际 diffusion LM 的 token-wise 参数化。其三，论文给出一个实现层面的推论：训练时可以只建模 P(X_i|Y_{-i}(τ))，再用已知 channel likelihood 做倾斜修正得到目标后验。这和 masked LM / pseudo-likelihood / leave-one-out 风格目标有明显亲缘关系，但这里给出了更一般的噪声路径版本。其四，作者反复强调 matched 与 mismatched 的分界：在无限容量、精确后验时，不同 channel 的积分都守恒到同一个 CE；但有限容量下，不同 channel 对后验族的逼近难度不同，因此会出现 channel-dependent gap。也就是说，理论上等价，不代表有限模型下训练等价。
summary.experiments:
实验分三组，目的都不是刷任务分数，而是验证“有限容量 + 不同 channel 会产生不同 CE gap”这个核心命题。

第一组是 synthetic Markov source。这里数据分布可控，熵率已知，适合直接比较不同 noising path 下估计到的 CE 与真实 entropy / CE 的偏差。作者系统改变 alphabet size，并比较不同离散/连续 corruption。结论是：在 matched 理论下应当守恒的量，在有限模型下会出现明显偏差，而且 alphabet 越大、后验越复杂时，不同 channel 的差距越大。这说明 channel 选择确实改变了有限容量模型面对的函数逼近难度，而不是数值误差。

第二组是 text8 字符级语言建模。这里的重点不是和大规模 AR LLM 直接比，而是比较 discrete noising path 与 Gaussian noising path 在同等模型容量下的效果。论文报告了显著的 channel-dependent gap：某些离散路径更贴近字符空间的离散结构，有限容量 denoiser 更容易学；而 Gaussian/embedding 风格路径虽然理论上也能通过 conservation law 对应到 CE，但在字符级建模上会引入更难的后验几何。全文里这部分最值得看的是不同噪声路径下 token-level NLL / CE 的分解曲线，以及不同 τ 区间对总 CE 的贡献，能帮助判断模型究竟卡在高噪声恢复还是低噪声精修。

第三组是 CIFAR-10 图像建模。作者用它来说明这种 channel-dependent finite-capacity effect 不是文本特有现象，在高维视觉数据上也存在。也就是说，守恒律给出的是统一理论，但真正决定实践效果的是“给定模型族能否高效逼近该 channel 下的后验族”。

摘要里明确给出一个定量结果方向：在 synthetic、text8、CIFAR-10 上都观察到 large finite-capacity, channel-dependent gaps。你在精读时应重点找正文中的具体 CE / bits-per-dim / NLL 数值表和不同 channel 的对比图，因为论文的价值不在单一绝对数字，而在这些数字如何随 alphabet、噪声类型、模型容量变化。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“理论主线—实现推论—实验验证”来读。

第一遍先看 Introduction 和主定理，抓住三件事：守恒的对象是 data-model cross-entropy，不只是 entropy；适用范围是广义 memoryless noising path；有限容量下 channel choice 会变成实际设计变量。这里不要被 GEXIT 名字吓住，核心就是把沿噪声轴的信息损失写成局部导数积分。

第二遍重点看理论部分里从 joint conditional entropy 导数到 coordinate-wise local derivative 的推导，以及 mismatched CE 版本的公式。要特别留意作者对绝对连续性、可交换微分与积分、memoryless 假设的条件说明。这些地方决定了结论能推广到哪些 diffusion LM 设定，哪些不能。若你做离散 diffusion 或 masked LM，这部分最值得深挖的是“只需边缘后验”的证明，因为它直接关系到参数化是否必须建模联合结构。

第三遍看 implementation implication。重点找作者如何把 P(X_i|Y(τ)) 改写成 P(X_i|Y_{-i}(τ)) 加 channel tilt，以及这和常见 denoiser 输出形式的对应关系。如果你关心训练 recipe，这部分会比纯理论更有操作性。

最后看实验。优先看 synthetic Markov source，因为它最干净，能直接验证守恒律与 finite-capacity gap。然后看 text8，理解离散与 Gaussian path 在文本上的差异。CIFAR-10 主要用来确认现象的普遍性。预计完整精读需要 1.5 到 2.5 小时；如果只抓对 pretrain 有用的部分，主定理、实现推论、text8 实验三块最关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a foundational question for diffusion language modeling: what is the exact relationship between local denoising objectives and global likelihood-scale quantities such as data-model cross-entropy, for general memoryless noising paths? Prior analyses were fragmented. Gaussian diffusion is tied to I-MMSE, and some discrete settings such as masking admit specialized derivations, but there was no single formulation covering both discrete and continuous diffusion under model mismatch. The paper develops such a formulation: a generalized GEXIT conservation law showing that the data-model cross-entropy can be written exactly as an integral of local information-theoretic derivatives along the noise path. Under memoryless corruption, these derivatives can be computed from marginal posteriors rather than the full joint posterior.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it gives a unified likelihood view of diffusion across discrete and continuous channels, which helps place diffusion LM on firmer footing relative to autoregressive modeling. Second, it clarifies the training target: in the matched case, learning reduces to token-level negative log-likelihood, and marginal posteriors are sufficient. That matters for objective design, parameterization, and noise-level sampling in discrete diffusion, masked LM, and embedding-space diffusion. Third, it makes a practical point that is easy to miss in purely asymptotic theory: different noising channels are equivalent only with exact posteriors. With finite-capacity denoisers, channels induce different approximation gaps, so the noise path becomes an actionable design choice rather than a cosmetic implementation detail.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical starting point is a telescoping identity over the degradation path from clean data to pure noise. Conditional entropy, and more generally data-model cross-entropy, can be expressed as the integral of its derivative with respect to the noise parameter. The nontrivial step is to turn the derivative of a joint quantity into something local and usable. The paper imports the EXIT/GEXIT machinery from coding theory and proves that for memoryless channels, the derivative decomposes into a sum of coordinate-wise local derivatives.

The main result is a mismatched conservation law for cross-entropy. Instead of assuming the denoiser equals the true posterior, the analysis allows a learned posterior family and shows that the global data-model CE is exactly the integral of local information derivatives along the noise axis. This yields several concrete consequences. One, the framework is channel-agnostic at the level of admissible memoryless corruption and recovers familiar special cases such as the Gaussian I-MMSE relation. Two, there is a locality property: the relevant derivatives depend only on marginal posteriors P(X_i | Y(τ)), not on the full joint posterior P(X | Y(τ)). This is a major simplification for high-dimensional sequence modeling. Three, the paper derives an implementation-oriented implication: it is sufficient to model an extrinsic posterior of the form P(X_i | Y_{-i}(τ)) and combine it with the known channel likelihood through a tilt. That connects the theory to practical token-wise denoisers and to leave-one-out style parameterizations. Four, the paper makes a sharp distinction between matched and mismatched regimes. In the matched limit, all admissible channels conserve the same CE. In finite-capacity settings, however, different channels define posterior families of different complexity, which leads to channel-dependent performance gaps.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate the finite-capacity claim rather than to optimize benchmark rankings.

The first set uses synthetic Markov sources with known entropy rates. This setting allows direct comparison between the theoretically conserved quantity and what finite denoisers recover under different channels. By varying alphabet size, the paper shows that channel-dependent gaps grow when the posterior family becomes harder to approximate. This is the cleanest empirical support for the main thesis.

The second set studies character-level language modeling on text8. The key comparison is between discrete noising paths and Gaussian noising paths under comparable model capacity. The paper reports substantial channel-dependent differences in CE/NLL, indicating that some channels align better with the discrete structure of text and are easier for finite denoisers to learn. The most useful plots here are the decompositions over noise levels, which show where the model pays the CE cost along the path.

The third set uses CIFAR-10 to show that the same phenomenon is not specific to text. High-dimensional image data also exhibits large finite-capacity, channel-dependent gaps. The practical message is that the conservation law is universal, but the approximation burden imposed on a given model family is channel-specific.

The abstract already states the main empirical takeaway: synthetic data, text8, and CIFAR-10 all show large finite-capacity, channel-dependent gaps. When reading the full paper, the most important numbers are not a single headline metric but the CE, NLL, or bits-per-dim comparisons across channels, alphabet sizes, and capacities.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes. First, go through the introduction and the main theorem statements. The key points to lock in are: the conserved quantity is data-model cross-entropy, not just entropy; the scope is general memoryless noising processes; and channel choice matters in practice because of finite-capacity mismatch.

Second, study the derivation that turns the derivative of joint conditional entropy or CE into coordinate-wise local terms. Pay attention to the assumptions behind differentiability, absolute continuity, and the memoryless factorization. These details determine how far the result can be extended to practical diffusion LM variants. If your interest is discrete diffusion or masked LM, the most important part is the proof that marginal posteriors are sufficient.

Third, focus on the implementation implication: how P(X_i | Y(τ)) is related to an extrinsic posterior P(X_i | Y_{-i}(τ)) plus a channel-dependent tilt. This is the bridge from theory to trainable denoisers.

For experiments, start with the synthetic Markov source section because it isolates the mechanism cleanly. Then read text8 for the language-modeling implications. CIFAR-10 mainly serves as a universality check. A careful read will likely take 1.5 to 2.5 hours.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型似然的统一理论框架，直接改变Diffusion LM训练目标的设计思路，应立刻在离散扩散预训练ablation中验证局部训练推论。
recommendation.en: Unified theoretical framework for diffusion likelihood, directly reshapes Diffusion LM training objective design; the locality corollary should be immediately validated in discrete diffusion pretraining ablations.

paper.title: From Global to Factor-Wise Expert Composition in Discrete Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models offer a powerful framework for solving complex reasoning tasks, particularly through compositional generation, which combines multiple pre-trained experts to generalize beyond their individual training data. Recent theoretical corrections introduce time-dependent mixing weights to better align composed diffusion dynamics with the intended target. However, these methods are fundamentally limited by working on a per-sample basis, treating each generated state monolithical

summary.core_problem: 现有离散扩散模型的专家组合采用逐样本全局标量加权，无法适配专家存在空间或功能专长的场景，在需局部逻辑约束的组合生成任务上性能受限。
summary.importance: 对离散扩散建模范式（包括MDLM、LLaDA这类与LLM相关的离散扩散）的推理时专家组合有直接参考价值，因子级路由思路可扩展到统一多模态模型的跨专家组合，也为ARC-AGI这类离散推理任务的扩散建模提供了更细粒度的组合范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FactorDiff因子级组合框架，将生成状态分解为用户定义的因子（如网格任务中的每个位置），采样时按因子动态分配不同专家的权重，而非对整份样本施加统一权重。同时设计原生2D掩码扩散架构，保留网格拓扑结构，便于训练互补专家并在推理时按位置组合预测。方案基于MDLM吸收态掩码扩散框架实现。
summary.experiments: 在ARC-AGI网格推理基准上测试，与SuperDiff、RNE、Feynman-Kac校正等全局标量加权基线相比，FactorDiff取得一致性能提升，在专家互补性强的任务上提升幅度最大，验证了位置级路由相比全局加权能更好适配局部空间约束。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节FactorDiff框架的因子路由机制，以及第4节的2D扩散架构设计；实验部分重点关注ARC-AGI上与全局加权基线的对比结果。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current expert composition methods for discrete diffusion models use per-sample global scalar weights that fail to account for expert spatial or functional specializations, limiting performance on compositional tasks requiring local logical constraints.
summary_en.importance: Directly relevant to inference-time expert composition in discrete diffusion language modeling paradigms including MDLM and LLaDA. The factor-wise routing idea can be extended to cross-expert composition in unified multimodal models, and provides a finer-grained composition framework for discrete reasoning benchmarks like ARC-AGI.
summary_en.technical_approach: FactorDiff is a factor-wise composition framework that decomposes the generation state into user-defined factors (e.g., individual positions in grid tasks) and dynamically routes expert contributions per factor during sampling, instead of applying uniform weights across the entire sample. A native 2D masked diffusion architecture that preserves grid topology is also introduced to train complementary experts for position-level composition. The framework is built on the MDLM absorbing-state masked diffusion paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the ARC-AGI grid reasoning benchmark. FactorDiff consistently outperforms global scalar-weight baselines including SuperDiff, RNE, and Feynman-Kac correctors, with the largest gains on tasks with highly specialized complementary experts. Position-level routing better accommodates local spatial constraints compared to global weighting.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 3 (FactorDiff factor routing mechanism) and Section 4 (native 2D diffusion architecture design). In the experiments section, prioritize comparison results against global weighting baselines on ARC-AGI. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读采样路由机制即可；若做 diffusion/any-order LM，可把 factor-wise expert routing 当作组合生成的候选先验。
recommendation.en: Read the sampling and routing mechanism; for diffusion or any-order LMs, factor-wise expert routing is a useful prior for compositional generation.

paper.title: What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn?
paper.abstract: What does a discrete diffusion model learn: a denoiser, a score ratio, or a bridge plug-in predictor? At the level of jump rates, these are one object in different coordinates, and reading a neural network in the wrong coordinate changes the process being trained and sampled. Starting with a rigorous derivation of the continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) ELBO for any noising process, boundary terms included, we prove the \emph{Oracle Distance} theorem: the negative ELBO is exactly equal to the da

summary.core_problem: 澄清离散扩散模型到底在学习什么：去噪器、score ratio，还是 bridge plug-in predictor，以及这些表述在连续时间跳转率层面如何对应。
summary.importance: 这是离散扩散语言建模的基础问题。贡献类型偏理论和建模范式分析：作者给出任意 noising process 下 CTMC ELBO 的严格推导，并说明错误地用坐标解释网络输出会改变实际训练和采样的过程。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从连续时间马尔可夫链的反向跳转率出发，推导包含边界项的 CTMC ELBO。核心结果是 Oracle Distance theorem：负 ELBO 精确等于数据熵加上 oracle reverse process 到 learned reverse process 的 path KL，而不只是一个松的下界。最优网络对应真实反向跳转率在当前 noisy state 条件下的条件期望；不可约代价等于 forward process 破坏 clean data 信息的速率，即 -dI(Z0; Zt)/dt。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看主要是理论论文，未能确认大规模语言模型实验、参数量或训练语料规模。摘要中强调对序列 token-factorizing 情形的结论，但具体实验设置和数值结果无法从给定信息确认。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 ETH Zurich、Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems、ELLIS Institute Tübingen。Bernhard Schölkopf 是因果学习和统计学习领域知名学者，Thomas Hofmann 在机器学习和信息检索领域有长期代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what a discrete diffusion model actually learns: a denoiser, a score ratio, or a bridge plug-in predictor, and how these views map to jump rates in continuous time.
summary_en.importance: This is a foundational question for discrete diffusion language modeling. The contribution is mainly theoretical: it derives the CTMC ELBO for arbitrary noising processes and shows that reading the network in the wrong coordinate can change the process being trained and sampled.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors derive the CTMC ELBO, including boundary terms, from reverse jump rates. The central result is the Oracle Distance theorem: the negative ELBO is exactly the data entropy plus the path KL from the oracle reverse process to the learned reverse process, rather than merely a loose bound. The unique optimizer is the conditional expectation of the true reverse jump rate given the noisy state, and the irreducible cost is the rate at which the forward process destroys information about the clean data, -dI(Z0; Zt)/dt.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the provided abstract, this appears to be primarily a theory paper. Large-scale LM experiments, model sizes, datasets, and numerical gains are not confirmed from the available information.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from ETH Zurich, the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, and ELLIS Institute Tübingen. Bernhard Schölkopf is a well-known researcher in causal and statistical learning, and Thomas Hofmann has long-standing work in machine learning and information retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散 LM 的坐标系问题讲得很硬，应立刻检查自己实现里的 rate、score、denoiser 是否混用。
recommendation.en: A sharp theory paper on coordinates in discrete diffusion LMs; it is worth checking whether your own rate, score, and denoiser parameterizations are being mixed.

paper.title: Tensor-Train Joint Modeling for Few-Step Discrete Diffusion
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion promises orders-of-magnitude faster generation than autoregressive (AR) models for sequential discrete data, yet its full potential of few-step generation has remained out of reach due to a fundamental structural limitation. The conditional-independence assumption underlying current discrete diffusion models introduces a systematic parallelization bias that compounds with the number of tokens unmasked per step, becoming severe in the few-step regime that fast generation requir

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散模型（尤其是Masked Diffusion Model）在少步生成时存在严重的parallelization bias——条件独立假设将 p(x|x_t) 分解为各位置边际概率的乘积，当单步同时unmask多个token时，token间的条件依赖被忽略，生成质量随步数减少而系统性下降。
summary.importance: 直指离散扩散能否真正实现对AR模型速度优势的核心瓶颈。现有缓解方案要么依赖辅助AR模型（增加系统复杂度），要么引入隐变量（依赖隐式建模），本方法在扩散模型内部显式建模联合分布，不依赖外部模型，且可通过轻量微调应用于已有预训练MDM，工程落地成本低。
summary.technical_approach: 用张量分解参数化条件联合分布 p(x|x_t)，将标准MDM的逐位置独立输出作为rank-1特例严格泛化。具体支持两种分解：CP分解（CPD）和Tensor-Train分解（TTD）。理论上证明TTD通过Oseledets定理具有对邻近token依赖的结构性偏置，天然适配序列数据。采样方面提出基于链式法则的迭代边际推断流程，利用缓存和并行前缀和实现高效采样，针对预定位置unmask调度有专门优化。微调时通过特殊初始化保持原有边际预测不变，仅新增少量参数建模联合依赖。
summary.experiments: 在OpenWebText、LM1B文本生成和QM9分子生成上验证，覆盖MDLM和VADD两个基模型。TTD在序列领域一致优于CPD，增益集中在少步区间。VADD+TTD在OpenWebText 8步生成困惑度上比vanilla VADD降低32.7%，128步时推理速度仅慢1.7%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Introduction中parallelization bias的结构性分析（这是理解少步生成困难的关键），以及TTD局部依赖偏置的理论论证（与CPD的对比揭示了为什么TTD更适合序列）。采样算法部分关注边际推断的缓存和前缀和优化逻辑。微调初始化技巧有实用价值。张量分解的代数细节可按需略读。预计精读40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion models (particularly Masked Diffusion Models) suffer from severe parallelization bias in the few-step generation regime: the conditional independence assumption factorizes p(x|x_t) as a product of per-position marginals, ignoring inter-token dependencies when multiple tokens are unmasked simultaneously, causing systematic quality degradation as step count decreases.
summary_en.importance: Addresses the core bottleneck preventing discrete diffusion from realizing its speed advantage over autoregressive models. Prior mitigations either rely on auxiliary AR models (adding system complexity) or introduce latent variables (implicit modeling). This approach explicitly models the joint distribution within the diffusion model itself without external dependencies, and can be applied to pretrained MDMs via lightweight fine-tuning with low engineering cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Parameterizes the conditional joint distribution p(x|x_t) via tensor decomposition, strictly generalizing standard MDMs as the rank-1 case. Supports two decompositions: Canonical Polyadic Decomposition (CPD) and Tensor-Train Decomposition (TTD). TTD is shown theoretically to have a structural bias toward local token dependencies via Oseledets' theorem, naturally suiting sequential data. Sampling uses an iterative marginal inference procedure based on the chain rule, with caching and parallel prefix sums for efficiency, plus specialization for predetermined unmasking schedules. Fine-tuning uses a special initialization that preserves original marginal predictions, adding only a small number of parameters for joint dependency modeling.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on OpenWebText, LM1B (text generation), and QM9 (molecule generation), covering MDLM and VADD base models. TTD consistently outperforms CPD on sequential domains, with gains concentrated in the few-step regime. VADD+TTD reduces 8-step generative perplexity on OpenWebText by 32.7% over vanilla VADD, with only 1.7% slowdown at 128 timesteps.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the structural analysis of parallelization bias in the Introduction (key to understanding few-step generation difficulty) and the theoretical argument for TTD's local dependency bias (the CPD vs TTD comparison reveals why TTD fits sequences better). In the sampling algorithm, pay attention to the caching and prefix-sum optimization logic for marginal inference. The fine-tuning initialization trick is practically useful. Heavy tensor algebra details can be skimmed. Estimated 40 minutes for a thorough read.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和少步实验即可；它把 DLM 的瓶颈从网络容量转向联合分布因子化，值得在内部小模型复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and few-step results; it reframes the DLM bottleneck as joint-distribution factorization, worth reproducing on small internal setups.

paper.title: DELTA-TTS: Adapting Autoregressive Model into Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) text-to-speech (TTS) models generate discrete speech tokens sequentially, which makes inference slow and can degrade robustness by propagating local errors and hallucinations. This limitation stems from their left-to-right AR commitment: each token must be determined before future speech-token context is available. However, such ordering is not an inherent requirement for TTS, as the full input text is available before synthesis. In this paper, we introduce DELTA-TTS, a light

summary.core_problem: 将已训练好的自回归 TTS 模型转换为离散扩散语言模型时，文本领域常用的 AR→dLLM 适配方法直接迁移到语音会明显掉点；语音 token 具有强局部相关性和已知文本条件，简单改双向注意力不足以恢复质量，也无法解决低置信度 token 过早提交导致的错误累积。
summary.importance: 属于语音 LM 建模范式方向的应用型适配工作，不是预训练基础方法论文。主要启发点在于：(1) 展示了用少量 LoRA 参数把 causal AR LM 改成双向掩码离散扩散模型可行，且不需要对 mask 做渐进退火；(2) 指出局部结构建模（卷积）和置信度调度对非自回归语音生成很关键。对纯文本 AR→diffusion LM 转换也有参考价值，但贡献集中在 TTS 场景。
summary.technical_approach: 以 CosyVoice3（Qwen2-0.5B 语义 token LM + flow-matching 声码器）为 backbone，冻结原权重和 tokenizer/decoder，只做三处改动：一是把 causal mask 换成 bidirectional mask，目标语音段随机 mask 后做恢复；二是在每个 transformer block 上加 LoRA 适配注意力与 FFN 的投影，并额外插入 Conformer 风格的 depthwise-conv + GLU 残差分支建模局部声学依赖；三是训练用 1/t 加权的 masked 重建目标，推理采用 time-shifted schedule，把低置信度 token 推迟到后续步再确定。整个适配只新增约 15% 参数，避免直接改动预训练权重。
summary.experiments: 在 585 小时 LibriTTS 上训练/适配，Seed-TTS test-en 上 WER 1.75%，推理速度比 AR backbone 快 3.3×。关键消融显示：文本域 naive AR→dLLM 转换在语音上性能明显下降，加卷积模块能恢复对齐和质量；置信度分析中 AR 模型在多个解码步置信度低，DELTA-TTS 整段置信度更平稳，幻觉和生成失败更少。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看方法部分关于双向 mask + LoRA 适配为何可以去掉 mask annealing 的解释，以及卷积模块为什么专门补救语音局部相关性；置信度对比和 WER/速度数字值得扫一眼。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When converting a pretrained autoregressive TTS model into a discrete diffusion language model, standard text-domain AR-to-dLLM adaptation recipes transfer poorly to speech. Speech tokens have strong local acoustic correlations and are generated with fully known text conditioning; simply switching to bidirectional attention is insufficient to recover quality or prevent early commitment to low-confidence tokens, which causes error accumulation.
summary_en.importance: An applied adaptation paper in the speech-language-modeling direction rather than a foundational pretraining-method contribution. Its main relevance is twofold: (1) it shows that a causal AR LM can be converted into a bidirectional masked/diffusion-style generator with lightweight LoRA adapters and without a gradual mask-annealing schedule; (2) it highlights that local-structure modeling and confidence-aware scheduling matter for non-autoregressive speech generation. Some design choices are also informative for text AR-to-diffusion LM conversion, but the empirical contribution is centered on TTS.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from CosyVoice3 (a Qwen2-0.5B semantic speech-token LM plus a frozen flow-matching waveform decoder), the backbone weights, speech tokenizer, and waveform decoder are kept frozen. Three changes are introduced. First, the causal self-attention mask is replaced by a bidirectional mask, and target speech spans are randomly masked for denoising/reconstruction. Second, LoRA adapters are added to attention and FFN projections in every transformer block, together with a Conformer-style residual branch (depthwise convolution + GLU gating) to model local acoustic dependencies. Third, training uses a 1/t-weighted masked reconstruction objective, and inference applies a time-shifted schedule so that uncertain tokens are deferred to later refinement steps. Total added parameters are around 15% of the backbone.
summary_en.experiments: Adapted on 585 hours of LibriTTS. On Seed-TTS test-en, DELTA-TTS reaches 1.75% WER with 3.3× faster generation than the AR backbone. Ablations show that a naive text-style AR-to-dLLM conversion degrades speech quality substantially, while the convolution module restores sharp text–speech alignment. Confidence analysis indicates that the AR backbone produces low-confidence predictions at multiple generation steps, whereas DELTA-TTS maintains higher confidence across the sequence and reduces hallucinations / catastrophic generation failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the method section explaining why bidirectional masking plus LoRA makes mask annealing unnecessary, and why the convolution module is needed specifically for local speech structure. The confidence analysis and the WER/speed trade-off numbers are worth a quick pass. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看 §3 的适配目标和推理 schedule；若结果稳，语音 token 不必固守 AR 是可复用信号。
recommendation.en: Read the adaptation loss and inference schedule; if the results hold, speech-token generation need not stay strictly AR.

paper.title: Set Diffusion: Interpolating Token Orderings Between Autoregression and Diffusion for Fast and Flexible Decoding
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models have steadily improved in quality relative to autoregressive (AR) models. However, these models are normally constrained to fixed-length generation and do not support key-value (KV) caching. Block diffusion partially bridges diffusion and AR by generating token blocks left-to-right, but its fixed-size sequential blocks limit decoding flexibility and parallelism. Here, we present a new class of language models, set diffusion, comprised of (i) a likelihood parameterizatio

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是离散 diffusion language model 在解码形态上的两个硬限制：多数模型需要固定长度、全双向上下文，难以做 KV cache；block diffusion 虽然把 diffusion 放进左到右的块内生成，支持变长和部分缓存，但块大小和块顺序固定，导致 infilling、任意位置插入、滑动窗口生成不自然，并且一个 block 内部完成前不能更新 KV cache。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对非 AR 语言建模有直接参考价值。它不是简单调 block size，而是把生成单位从连续 block 改成任意位置、任意长度的 token set，用生成顺序来插值 AR 和 diffusion。这个角度比较关键：AR 的优势来自可缓存和稳定的条件分解，diffusion 的优势来自并行和任意顺序生成；set diffusion 试图把两者放在同一个 likelihood parameterization 里，而不是只在采样器层面做折中。对预训练研究的启发在于，非 AR LM 如果要进入通用语言建模，必须同时处理 likelihood、变长生成、缓存、任意位置编辑这几个接口问题。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是定义一个对 token set 自回归分解的语言模型。每一步不再生成一个 token，也不要求生成固定连续 block，而是生成一个 flexible-position、flexible-length 的 token 集合。固定左到右连续集合时，它退化为 block diffusion；集合大小为 1 且严格左到右时，接近普通 AR；集合位置更随机、集合更大时，则更接近 diffusion 的并行去噪。模型还引入 set-causal diffusion architecture，使已完成的 token set 可以在每个推理 step 后写入 KV cache，而不是像 block diffusion 那样等整个 block 去噪结束。解码时可以选择不同 ordering policy，例如偏左到右、随机位置、用于 infilling 的任意位置补全，因而把质量、速度、可编辑性放进同一个可调空间。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理、摘要、无条件生成和 infilling。论文报告 set diffusion 在多个任务上比已有 diffusion LM 有更好的速度-质量折中，并且在 infilling 上明显优于 block diffusion。图 1 给出的 GSM8K 曲线显示，set diffusion 在约 80 到 160 tokens/sec 的范围内取得约 55% 到 65% 的测试准确率，曲线整体优于 block diffusion 的对应设置。实验重点不是单点分数，而是不同生成顺序、集合大小和缓存策略带来的 Pareto 曲线变化。消融最值得看的是 ordering bias 和 set size 对质量、并行度、KV-cache 更新频率的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认它相对 block diffusion 解决了什么具体接口问题。随后看方法部分中 likelihood factorization over sets 和 set-causal attention mask 的定义，这是核心创新。实验部分重点看 GSM8K speed-accuracy 曲线、infilling 对比、以及不同 token ordering 的消融。背景部分可以快速跳过，除非需要补齐 D3PM、MDLM、block diffusion 的公式关系。
summary.authors_note: Cornell University Department of Computer Science；文中通信作者为 Marianne Arriola，代码仓库位于 kuleshov-group/setdlms，显示与 Kuleshov group 相关。完整作者列表无法从给定内容确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical limitation of discrete diffusion language models: they usually require fixed-length generation and bidirectional context, which makes variable-length decoding and KV caching difficult. Block diffusion improves this by generating left-to-right blocks, but fixed contiguous blocks still constrain infilling, arbitrary-position insertion, and parallel decoding. It also cannot update the KV cache until a whole block has been denoised.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a cleaner interface between autoregressive language modeling and diffusion-style denoising. Instead of interpolating by changing a fixed block size, the paper interpolates by changing the order and size of token sets. This matters for pretraining research because non-AR language models need more than fast sampling; they need a likelihood parameterization, variable-length generation, cache compatibility, and editing-friendly decoding. Set diffusion is an attempt to put these requirements into one modeling family.
summary_en.technical_approach: Set diffusion defines an autoregressive distribution over flexible token sets. A decoding step can generate tokens at arbitrary positions and with arbitrary set sizes. If the sets are constrained to fixed contiguous left-to-right blocks, the model recovers block diffusion. If the sets become singletons with a left-to-right order, the behavior approaches AR decoding. If the sets are larger and more randomly ordered, the behavior moves toward diffusion-style parallel denoising. The architecture uses a set-causal design so that completed sets can be committed to the KV cache after every inference step. This is the key difference from block diffusion, where within-block bidirectional denoising delays cache updates.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates mathematical reasoning, summarization, unconditional generation, and infilling. The reported results emphasize speed-quality tradeoffs rather than a single operating point. In the GSM8K plot, set diffusion operates roughly in the 80 to 160 tokens/sec range with about 55% to 65% test accuracy, and its curve is better than the block diffusion curve shown in the figure. The paper also reports strong gains over block diffusion on infilling, where arbitrary-position sets are a natural fit. The most informative ablations are the ones varying generation order, set size, and the degree of left-to-right bias.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand the failure mode of block diffusion. Then read the method sections defining the set-factorized likelihood and the set-causal architecture. In the experiments, focus on the GSM8K speed-accuracy curve, the infilling results, and ablations over ordering policies. The diffusion background can be skimmed unless the reader wants to verify the relation to D3PM, MDLM, and block diffusion.
summary_en.authors_note: Cornell University Department of Computer Science. The supplied text lists Marianne Arriola as the corresponding author and links code under kuleshov-group/setdlms, indicating involvement from the Kuleshov group. The full author list is not available in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 集扩散突破了离散扩散的固定块限制，同时兼容KV缓存，对提升扩散LM的推理效率与实用性很有启发，重点看集因果架构设计。
recommendation.en: Set diffusion breaks the fixed-block constraint of discrete diffusion while supporting KV caching, insightful for improving diffusion LM inference efficiency; focus on the set-causal architecture.

paper.title: Accelerating Discrete Diffusion Models with Parallel-In-Time Sampling
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models are widely used for learning and generating discrete distributions. As the generation process is inherently sequential, the acceleration of sampling is of significant importance. In this work, we parallelize the mainstream $τ$-leaping algorithm for absorbing discrete diffusion in a Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) framework. By leveraging the continuous-time stochastic integral form of the $τ$-leaping algorithm and the Picard iteration method, we achieve parallel-in-

summary.core_problem: 吸收式离散扩散模型（包括MDLM、LLaDA这类掩码离散扩散语言模型）的现有采样算法（τ-leaping、精确采样等）沿时间维度顺序执行，时间复杂度随序列长度线性增长，无法充分利用GPU并行算力，推理速度远低于自回归模型，是离散扩散LM落地的核心瓶颈之一。
summary.importance: 这是离散扩散采样加速方向的理论与方法进展，给出了时间维度并行的离散扩散采样算法，将采样步数从线性级降到多对数级，对离散扩散类非自回归语言模型的推理效率提升有参考价值，为这类模型缩小与自回归模型的推理速度差距提供了新的技术路径。
summary.technical_approach: 基于连续时间马尔可夫链框架下τ-leaping算法的连续时间随机积分形式，引入Picard迭代实现时间维度的并行采样。核心设计有两点：一是将连续的细粒度采样步划分为多个大块，块内所有微步在每轮Picard迭代中基于上一轮的轨迹并行计算，共用块初始化时生成的随机数；二是针对吸收扩散的特性在块内做首达截断，保留掩码状态的吸收结构（即token一旦解掩码就不会回到掩码状态），让块更新可以适配并行前缀操作。理论上证明了Picard迭代的指数阶收缩特性，最终将采样时间复杂度从原τ-leaping的O(d log S)降到O(log(d log S)·log d)，其中d为序列长度，S为词表大小。
summary.experiments: 合成数据与真实离散生成任务上的验证显示，该方法相比顺序τ-leaping、MATU等现有采样方法可实现显著的采样效率提升；理论推导的多对数复杂度相比现有线性复杂度采样算法有量级上的改进，且方法与现有token维度的并行解码策略正交，可叠加使用获得进一步加速。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计20分钟。重点关注引言对现有离散扩散采样方法复杂度瓶颈的梳理、Picard τ-leaping的算法设计思路，以及收敛性证明的核心直觉；不做理论研究的读者可以跳过详细数学推导，重点关注时间并行方法和现有token并行解码策略的正交性，以及其适配文本生成任务的潜力。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing sampling algorithms for absorbing discrete diffusion models (including masked diffusion language models such as MDLM and LLaDA, e.g., τ-leaping and exact samplers) proceed sequentially along the time dimension, with time complexity scaling linearly with sequence length. This sequential structure prevents full utilization of GPU parallelism, leading to inference speeds far slower than autoregressive models, which remains a core bottleneck for real-world deployment of discrete diffusion LMs.
summary_en.importance: This work presents theoretical and algorithmic progress in discrete diffusion sampling acceleration. It introduces a parallel-in-time sampling algorithm for absorbing discrete diffusion that reduces sampling complexity from linear to polylogarithmic in sequence length. The result provides a new path to narrow the inference speed gap between non-autoregressive discrete diffusion models and standard autoregressive LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on the continuous-time stochastic integral form of the τ-leaping algorithm for continuous-time Markov chains, and leverages Picard iteration to enable parallelism across the time dimension. Two core design choices support this: first, fine-grained sequential sampling steps are grouped into larger blocks, where all microsteps within a block are evaluated in parallel during each Picard iteration, using shared randomness initialized at the start of the block. Second, a first-hitting truncation is applied within each block to respect the structure of absorbing diffusion (i.e., tokens remain unmasked once they leave the absorbing state), making block updates compatible with parallel prefix operations. Theoretically, the work proves exponential-factorial error contraction for the Picard iteration, reducing time complexity from O(d log S) for standard sequential τ-leaping to O(log(d log S)·log d), where d is sequence length and S is vocabulary size.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations on synthetic and real-world discrete generation tasks show substantial sampling efficiency gains over sequential τ-leaping and prior acceleration methods such as MATU. The theoretically derived polylogarithmic time complexity represents an order-of-magnitude improvement over the linear scaling of existing sequential samplers. The approach is also orthogonal to existing token-dimension parallel decoding strategies, allowing additional speedups when combined.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 20 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s taxonomy of existing discrete diffusion sampling bottlenecks, the high-level design of the Picard τ-leaping algorithm, and the core intuition behind the convergence proof. Detailed mathematical derivations can be skipped for readers not focused on theory; pay specific attention to the orthogonality between this time-parallel approach and existing token-parallel decoding strategies, as well as its applicability to text generation tasks.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散采样的核心算法突破，做非AR建模范式的必看§3的收敛证明，可直接复现用于离散扩散LM的推理加速
recommendation.en: Core algorithmic breakthrough for discrete diffusion sampling; read §3 for convergence proof, directly applicable to diffusion LM inference acceleration

paper.title: Retrieval-Warmed Energy-Based Reasoning: A Five-Arm Ablation Methodology for Diffusion-as-Inference on Structured Reasoning Tasks
paper.abstract: Warm-started diffusion samplers accelerate iterative inference, but it is rarely clear which part of the pipeline carries the gain. We study \textbf{retrieval-warmed energy-based reasoning (RW-EBR)} -- an IRED energy-based diffusion model \cite{du2024ired} augmented with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory -- and contribute a \textbf{five-arm ablation methodology} (oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, aligned) that separates three confounded effects: class-prior bias shift, stochas

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是检索 warm-start 在迭代式推理模型中到底为何有效的问题。作者不把准确率提升直接归因于“检索到了有用样本”，而是把收益拆成三类：初始化分布的类别先验偏移、每个 query 的随机扰动、以及与当前图结构对齐的历史解复用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型规模或训练 recipe，而在诊断方法。它提供了一套可迁移的消融设计，用来分析 retrieval-augmented diffusion / energy-based inference 中的收益来源。对 diffusion LM、masked iterative refinement、latent reasoning 这类非自回归推理框架有启发：warm-start 的收益需要区分“分布更好”“扰动打破坏平衡”和“内容真的对齐”，否则很容易把检索记忆的作用估计过高。论文的贡献量级偏方法学诊断，不是新的基座建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
作者在 IRED energy-based diffusion reasoning 模型外接 Modern Hopfield trajectory memory。基础任务是 connectivity-2：给定 Erdős–Rényi 图 G(N=12, p=0.2)，预测 all-pairs reachability matrix。基础模型使用 IRED 的 32-channel GraphEBM，训练 30k steps，10 个 diffusion timesteps，目标是对 ±1 缩放后的 reachability target 做 MSE denoising，并保留 IRED 的 energy-landscape supervision 和 inner-loop optimization。检索 key 由 3-layer GIN 产生，使用 label-ordered readout 而不是 sum-pool，因为 reachability matrix 需要与节点标签顺序对齐；还加入 per-position id embedding，避免度数对称结构坍缩。key encoder 用 supervised contrastive loss 训练 3000 steps，正样本来自 target-nearest neighbours，pair similarity 用 reachability 的 per-edge Hamming agreement。

核心是五臂消融：oracle、best-constant、per-query-random、shuffled、aligned。oracle 用金标准 memory 检验上限；best-constant 衡量固定初始化带来的类别先验偏移；per-query-random 衡量每个 query 随机 warm-start 是否单独有用；shuffled 保持 value 分布和检索机制，但打乱 key-value 配对；aligned 保持正确配对。aligned 与 shuffled 的差值用于隔离“内容是否与当前 query 对齐”。这个设计比只比较 cold-start 与 warm-start 更干净，因为它把 value 分布、检索噪声、配对关系分开控制。
summary.experiments:
connectivity-2 上，作者在固定 1000 图验证集、seed 20260420 上运行 warm-start 诊断。oracle memory 条件下，aligned 相比 shuffled 的 balanced accuracy 提升达到 +35 个百分点，说明主要收益来自图级别对齐的 value reuse。best-constant sweep 给出的 bias-shift 上界不超过 +8 个百分点；per-query-random 初始化为负收益，约 -1.5 到 -3.1 个百分点，说明随机扰动不是主要原因。可部署的 cold-prediction pipeline 未通过 -2 pp acceptance gate，实际 Δ balanced accuracy 为 -4.09 pp；同一套分解把失败定位到 stored-value quality，而不是 key encoder。

作者还在 Sudoku 上做了异质失败案例。使用任务特定 encoder、contrastive key training 和 quality-ratio gate，但在 key-quality screen 就失败：在当前 mask-aware solved-board target 与 500-candidate pool 设置下，key encoder 本身未达到质量门槛。这个结果与 connectivity-2 形成对照：connectivity 的瓶颈是 stored-value quality，Sudoku 的瓶颈是 key quality。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的三类混杂因素定义，以及 Methods 里五臂消融如何构造。connectivity-2 的 aligned、shuffled、best-constant、per-query-random 对比是核心结果；它比最终 end-to-end accuracy 更有信息量。若关心 diffusion-as-inference 或 retrieval-augmented iterative reasoning，可细看 key encoder 设计，尤其是为什么不能用 permutation-invariant readout。Sudoku 部分适合看作 failure attribution 示例，不必按新方法读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why retrieval warm-starting helps iterative reasoning models. It separates three effects that are usually conflated: a better class-prior initialization, query-specific stochastic perturbation, and reuse of a retrieved value that is actually aligned with the input structure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is methodological rather than scale-oriented. The five-arm diagnostic is useful for retrieval-augmented diffusion inference, energy-based reasoning, masked iterative refinement, and other non-AR inference schemes. The main lesson is that a warm-start gain should not be interpreted as evidence of useful retrieval unless value distribution, stochasticity, and key-value alignment are separately controlled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system wraps an IRED energy-based diffusion reasoning model with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory. The main task is connectivity-2: given an Erdős–Rényi graph G(N=12, p=0.2), predict its all-pairs reachability matrix. The base model is IRED’s 32-channel GraphEBM, trained for 30k steps with 10 diffusion timesteps and an MSE denoising objective on ±1-scaled targets, with energy-landscape supervision and inner-loop optimization enabled.

Retrieval keys are produced by a 3-layer GIN. The encoder uses a label-ordered readout instead of sum pooling, because the retrieved reachability matrix must preserve the node-label alignment of the query graph. A learned per-position ID embedding is added to avoid collapses in degree-symmetric cases. The key encoder is trained with supervised contrastive learning for 3000 steps; target-nearest neighbors are defined by Hamming agreement over reachability entries.

The main contribution is the five-arm ablation: oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, and aligned. The best-constant arm estimates how much can be gained by a favorable fixed initialization. The per-query-random arm tests whether stochastic perturbation alone helps. The shuffled arm keeps the value distribution and retrieval mechanics but permutes key-value pairings. The aligned arm keeps the correct pairing. The aligned-minus-shuffled gap isolates graph-aligned value reuse.
summary_en.experiments:
On connectivity-2, the warm-start diagnostic is run on a fixed validation set of 1,000 graphs with seed 20260420. Under oracle memory, aligned initialization outperforms shuffled initialization by +35 percentage points in balanced accuracy. The constant-initialization sweep bounds the class-prior bias effect at no more than +8 points. Per-query random initialization is negative, around -1.5 to -3.1 points. These results indicate that graph-aligned value reuse is the dominant source of the warm-start gain.

The deployable cold-prediction pipeline does not pass the -2 pp acceptance gate; its balanced-accuracy delta is -4.09 points. The decomposition localizes this failure to stored-value quality rather than key quality. A Sudoku case study shows a different bottleneck: with the current mask-aware solved-board target and a 500-candidate pool, the key encoder fails its quality gate. The diagnostic therefore identifies different first blocking components on the two tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The most useful parts are the definition of the three confounders and the construction of the five ablation arms. The aligned-versus-shuffled oracle comparison is the central result. Readers working on diffusion-as-inference or retrieval-augmented iterative refinement should also inspect the key encoder design, especially the choice of label-ordered readout. The Sudoku section is best read as a failure-attribution example rather than as a new solver.

recommendation.zh: 对离散扩散模型做推理的机制拆解很干净，五臂消融法值得借鉴，关注 Diffusion LM 推理机制的必看。
recommendation.en: Clean mechanism disentanglement for discrete diffusion inference; the five-arm ablation is worth adopting for those studying Diffusion LM reasoning.

paper.title: Approximate Structured Diffusion for Sequence Labelling
paper.abstract: Sequence labelling, a core task of Natural Language Processing (NLP), consists in assigning each token of an input sentence a label.   From a Machine Learning point of view, sequence labelling is often cast as a Linear-Chain Conditional Random Field (CRF) parametrised by a neural network.   While this approach gives good empirical results, CRFs assume a finite decision span (eg label bigrams) which can limit their expressivity and hurt performance when long-range dependencies are required.   We

summary.core_problem: 用扩散式结构化建模缓解传统线性链 CRF 在序列标注中只能建模有限标签跨度的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是建模方法改进。它不是 Diffusion LM，但把扩散过程用于离散标签序列，并让 CRF 条件于完整但带噪的标签序列，对研究离散扩散和结构化预测有边缘参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses diffusion-style structured modeling to address the limited label-span assumption of linear-chain CRFs in sequence labeling.

summary_en.technical_approach: The method treats sequence labeling as a neural CRF problem and introduces diffusion training. Instead of conditioning only on local label bigrams, the CRF is conditioned on a noisy version of the entire label sequence. Approximate CRF inference is used to handle the resulting structured dependency.

paper.title: Semantic DLM+: Improving Diffusion Language Models through Bias-variance Trade-off in Transition Kernel Design
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have demonstrated strong scaling capacity as alternatives to autoregressive language models. However, their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of transition kernels, and poorly designed kernels can lead to issues like training instability, slow convergence, and biased sampling. In this paper, we study this sensitivity through a principled analysis of generalization error and identify three critical factors: asymptotic bias (difficulty in approximating

summary.core_problem: Diffusion Language Models 对离散转移核高度敏感，错误的 kernel 会带来训练不稳定、收敛慢和采样偏差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是文本 diffusion LM 建模范式分析与方法改进。它不只是换一个 kernel，而是把 DLM kernel 选择拆成 asymptotic bias、exposure bias 和 optimization variance 的权衡，这对 MDLM/LLaDA/SEDD 这一类非 AR 语言模型有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从泛化误差角度分析 DLM transition kernel 的敏感性，指出三个因素：后验分布近似困难带来的渐近偏差、采样阶段错误传播带来的 exposure bias、kernel dispersion 引入的优化方差。它比较 masking diffusion 与 uniform diffusion：前者目标稀疏、后验更易近似，后者采样修复能力更强但近似更难。在此基础上重新引入 semantic DLM，让 token 腐蚀到语义相关 token，以在训练可学性和采样修复之间折中。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、训练 token 数、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。它声称 DLM 已展示强 scaling capacity，并围绕不同 transition kernels 的稳定性、收敛和采样偏差进行比较；具体数字需要看实验表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why Diffusion Language Models are highly sensitive to the choice of discrete transition kernels, where poor kernels cause instability, slow convergence, and biased sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is a modeling-paradigm contribution for text diffusion LMs. Its value is the bias-variance framing of kernel design rather than a superficial kernel swap, making it relevant to MDLM/LLaDA/SEDD-style alternatives to next-token AR modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes DLM transition kernels through generalization error and identifies three factors: asymptotic bias from posterior approximation difficulty, exposure bias from sampling-time error propagation, and optimization variance induced by kernel dispersion. It contrasts masking diffusion, which gives sparse and easier posterior targets, with uniform diffusion, which provides stronger sampling-side repair but harder approximation. Semantic DLM corrupts tokens toward semantically related alternatives to balance these forces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, token count, baselines, or numerical gains. It frames the empirical comparison around training stability, convergence speed, and sampling bias across transition kernels; the detailed results would need to be checked in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻读 kernel 分解和 semantic corruption 实验；这比单纯追 DLM loss 更能指导内部非 AR ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the kernel decomposition and semantic-corruption experiments; this is more actionable for non-AR LM ablations than another raw DLM loss comparison.

paper.title: Mean-Field Parallel Decoding for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a pathway to low-latency decoding. However, selecting tokens independently by marginal confidence limits effective parallelism: tokens that appear reliable in isolation can form incompatible configurations when several positions are updated at once. We introduce a training-free decoding framework that coordinates these parallel updates. At each forward pass, the method assigns a commit score to each masked position and

summary.core_problem: 离散 diffusion LM 虽然能并行生成 token，但独立按边际置信度提交多个位置时容易产生彼此冲突的配置，限制了有效并行度。
summary.importance: 这是对非 AR 文本生成范式的解码层改进，贡献不在训练而在生成机制：它指出 diffusion LM 的并行瓶颈并给出无需重训的协调式并行提交方法。对关注 D3PM/MDLM/LLaDA 一类建模的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 training-free 的 mean-field parallel decoding。每次前向先给每个 mask 位置一个 commit score，再利用模型预测分布导出的成对相互作用对这些分数做变分松弛下的 fixed-point 更新，从而抑制同一步内互相不兼容的 token 提交。核心思想是把“独立高置信”改成“联合一致性更高”的并行决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明该方法可直接插入现有 diffusion decoding pipeline，无需辅助模型或再训练，在保持有竞争力生成质量的同时提高每步可并行提交的 token 数。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度，因此结论强度仍需看正文中的解码步数、质量退化和 wall-clock 对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Lior Wolf。该团队长期做生成模型与离散建模，论文风格偏方法导向。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion LMs can generate tokens in parallel, but committing positions independently by marginal confidence often creates incompatible joint configurations and limits effective parallelism.
summary_en.importance: This is a decoding-side contribution for non-autoregressive text generation rather than a training recipe. It matters because it targets a real bottleneck in diffusion LMs and offers a drop-in way to improve coordinated parallel updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free mean-field parallel decoding method. It assigns commit scores to masked positions, then refines them using pairwise interactions derived from the model's predictive distributions. A variational relaxation yields a fixed-point update that suppresses conflicting simultaneous commitments within a single forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, the method plugs into existing diffusion decoding pipelines without retraining or auxiliary models, allowing more tokens to be committed in parallel while maintaining competitive generation quality. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, so the real value depends on the full decoding-quality and wall-clock tradeoff in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Lior Wolf, a well-known researcher in generative modeling and discrete modeling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，但只对做 diffusion LM 的人有用：重点看它怎样把独立置信改成联合一致性，若 wall-clock 没显著赢 AR，就只是解码小修补。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion LMs: the key idea is replacing marginal confidence with joint-consistency-aware commits; if wall-clock does not beat AR meaningfully, treat it as a local decoding fix.

paper.title: Efficient Reinforcement for Visual-Textual Thinking with Discrete Diffusion Model
paper.abstract: RL-based post-training has been widely adopted to enable interleaved visual and textual reasoning in unified multimodal models capable of both text and image generation. However, most existing approaches are built upon autoregressive (AR) unified models, which require full image regeneration during visual reasoning. In this work, we demonstrate that multimodal discrete diffusion models are effective alternatives to AR models for reinforcement learning in interleaved reasoning, owing to their abi

summary.core_problem: 解决统一多模态模型做视觉-文本交错推理时，AR 模型在 RL rollout 中需要完整重生成图像 token，导致训练计算开销高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态离散扩散模型上的 RL 后训练方法。它把 discrete diffusion 的局部编辑能力用于 visual rollout，并指出跨模态共享 reward 会在图像 token 和文本 token 之间产生干扰，对统一建模和后训练接口都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用 multimodal discrete diffusion model 替代 AR unified model 做 GRPO 式强化学习。核心利用扩散模型可局部编辑视觉区域的特性，避免每次视觉推理 rollout 都完整生成所有图像 token。同时提出 factorized reward assignment，将图像和文本相关 reward 分开分配，减少无关 token 序列之间的梯度干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告相较 AR baseline，visual rollout 计算减少 26.9%，同时性能下降很小。实验应包括视觉-文本交错推理任务、GRPO 后训练对比、AR 统一模型 baseline，以及 joint reward assignment 与 factorized reward assignment 的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the high RL rollout cost of AR unified multimodal models, which often need to regenerate full image-token sequences during interleaved visual-textual reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an RL post-training method for multimodal discrete diffusion models. It uses localized visual editing for cheaper rollouts and identifies cross-modal interference from shared reward assignment, which is relevant to the interface between unified modeling and post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a multimodal discrete diffusion model as an alternative to AR unified models under GRPO-style reinforcement learning. The key idea is to exploit localized visual editing instead of regenerating all image tokens. They also propose factorized reward assignment, separating image-related and text-related rewards to reduce gradient interference between unrelated token sequences.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 26.9% reduction in rollout computation relative to AR baselines with minimal performance drop. The experiments likely include interleaved visual-textual reasoning tasks, GRPO comparisons against AR unified models, and ablations of joint versus factorized reward assignment.

recommendation.zh: 读 factorized reward 消融；它把扩散式多模态生成的优势落到 RL 计算账和梯度干扰上。
recommendation.en: Read the factorized-reward ablation; it connects diffusion-style multimodal generation to concrete RL compute cost and gradient-interference issues.

paper.title: Beyond Fully Random Masking: Attention-Guided Denoising and Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an efficient alternative to autoregressive models through parallel decoding, yet existing post-training methods largely rely on random masking strategies that overlook intrinsic token dependencies. In this work, we present an empirical analysis of attention in dLLMs and show that tokens attending more strongly to unmasked context exhibit greater generation stability and play a critical role in reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose AGDO,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 在 post-training 阶段的一个结构性错配：训练时通常用 fully random masking 去决定哪些 token 被预测，但推理时模型是在多步 denoising 过程中逐步恢复 token，且每一步的可用上下文并不是随机形成的，而是由双向注意力下的真实依赖关系决定。作者想回答两个问题：一是 dLLM 在 denoising 过程中到底依赖哪些 token；二是能否把这种依赖显式写进 SFT 和 RL 的优化过程，而不是继续沿用对 AR 模型更自然、对 dLLM 其实并不贴合的随机掩码训练方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在于它提出了一个新的 base pretrain objective，而在于它把“full-attention masked/diffusion LM 的训练目标应当和真实生成轨迹对齐”这件事讲得更具体了。现有很多 dLLM post-training 方法只是把 AR 时代的 token-level 优化思路搬过来，再配一个随机 mask 或人为规定的解码顺序。这里的贡献是给出了一套来自模型内部 attention 结构的顺序信号，并把它同时用于 denoising order 和 loss/reward reweighting。对做 any-order LM、masked LM、diffusion LM 的人，这篇文章的价值在于：它提示 post-train recipe 不能只看目标函数形式，还要看生成轨迹是否与模型内部依赖结构一致。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 attention analysis。作者在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上沿 denoising trajectory 跟踪最后一层 attention，发现两个现象：其一，attention 在 masked generation 中是稀疏且跨 step 相对稳定的，单个 token 往往持续依赖少量上下文 token；其二，如果某个待生成 token 对“已经被去噪出来的 token”有更高 attention mass，那么它在后续 step 的预测概率更稳定，说明它更适合在当前阶段被恢复。这个观察直接否定了 fully random masking 的一个隐含假设：所有 masked token 在当前 step 的可预测性近似同质。

第二层是 AGDO 框架。核心做法是先从 valid attention score 中构造 attention-guided denoising order，再把这个顺序用于 post-training。这里的 valid attention 可以理解为：只统计指向当前可见、已解码或未被 mask 的上下文 token 的注意力，从而估计某个 masked token 当前是否已经拥有足够支撑它被恢复的上下文。AGDO 不是按固定位置顺序解码，也不是简单 blockwise，而是按 attention 支撑度决定谁先被 unmask。

在 SFT 阶段，AGDO-SFT 用 attention-guided order 构造训练样本和预测目标，减少训练-推理错配。除此之外，作者还引入 attention-based reweighting，对 attention-critical token，也就是在依赖图中更像 hub、对其他 token 预测更关键的 token，赋予更高损失权重。这样做的理由很直接：这些 token 一旦预测错，会沿后续 denoising step 传播错误。

在 RL 阶段，AGDO-RL 建立在已有 dLLM 的 GRPO/mean-field 近似路线之上，但同样把 attention-guided order 和 token reweighting 纳入优化。也就是说，它不是只在 sample-level 上根据最终 reward 调整，而是让 credit assignment 更偏向那些对后续推理链条更关键的 token。和 diff-GRPO、wd1 这类方法相比，区别不在 RL 框架本身，而在于它把 policy optimization 的作用位置从“随机选中的 masked token”改成了“按 attention 依赖组织起来的 token 子集”。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验主轴放在数学和代码推理任务上，核心结论是 AGDO 在这两类需要多步依赖传播的任务上稳定优于随机 masking 的 post-training 方法，以及优于外部规定顺序的若干变体。正文明确提到主要分析模型是 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B，并在附录上验证到 LLaDA，说明结论不是单模型特例。

更值得注意的是实验设计背后的因果链，而不只是最终分数。作者先用 MATH-500 做 attention tracing，展示 attention map 在 denoising step 间的时间一致性，以及“更多依赖已解码 token 的位置，其生成概率更稳定”这一统计关系。这个分析相当于给后续方法提供了机制证据。随后在 SFT 和 RL 两个阶段分别比较 random masking、blockwise 或 left-to-right 等顺序策略，结论是 attention-guided order 更适合 full-attention dLLM。消融上，应该重点看两类：一类是只改 denoising order、不做 reweighting；另一类是保留 order、去掉 attention-based token weighting。若两者都带来增益，说明收益既来自轨迹对齐，也来自更合理的 credit assignment。

由于提供的全文片段没有完整表格和具体 benchmark 数字，无法可靠复述精确提升幅度、训练 token 数或 RL 采样规模；但从论文叙述看，作者强调的是 consistent improvement 而不是单点大幅跃升，说明方法更像 recipe 改进而非架构替换。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Attention Analysis。这里决定这篇文章是否值得继续读：如果你认同“dLLM 的 token 依赖应由 attention 而不是位置先验决定”，后面的算法就顺理成章。然后看方法部分里 attention-guided denoising order 的定义，重点弄清楚 valid attention score 是如何计算的、顺序是按 step 动态更新还是一次性预估、训练时如何避免信息泄漏。再看 AGDO-SFT 与 AGDO-RL 的损失设计，尤其是 token reweighting 的公式和它与 mean-field RL 近似如何兼容。

实验部分建议优先看：1）attention 可视化与稳定性统计；2）不同 unmasking order 的对比；3）去掉 reweighting 的消融；4）数学与代码任务上是否都成立。如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要深挖，值得追问两个点：第一，attention 是否真能作为依赖因果的代理，还是只是相关信号；第二，这套方法在 base pretraining 阶段是否也能成立，而不只是 post-training recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural mismatch in post-training diffusion language models. Most existing dLLM post-training methods optimize randomly masked positions, while inference proceeds through iterative denoising where the available context is formed by the model’s evolving bidirectional dependencies rather than by random masking. The paper asks two concrete questions: what token dependencies actually emerge during denoising, and whether SFT/RL can be aligned to those dependencies instead of inheriting masking schemes that are convenient but poorly matched to full-attention dLLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not a new base objective, but a sharper formulation of training-trajectory alignment for non-AR language models. Many diffusion or masked LM post-training recipes still borrow token-level optimization patterns from AR models and then add random masks or externally imposed decoding orders. This work argues that the denoising trajectory should be induced by the model’s own attention structure. That is useful for diffusion LM, any-order LM, and masked LM research because it shifts the discussion from objective form alone to the interaction between objective, decoding path, and internal dependency structure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. First is an empirical attention study. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, the authors trace final-layer attention along the denoising trajectory and report two main findings: attention is sparse and temporally stable across steps, and tokens that place more attention mass on already-denoised context exhibit more stable generation probabilities. This suggests that masked tokens are not equally predictable at a given step, which directly challenges fully random masking.

Second is AGDO, an attention-guided denoising and optimization framework. It derives an attention-guided denoising order from valid attention scores, where the key idea is to estimate whether a masked token already has enough support from currently visible or denoised context. Instead of decoding by position or by random selection, AGDO unmasks tokens according to attention-supported readiness.

AGDO-SFT uses this order during supervised fine-tuning, reducing the mismatch between training and inference trajectories. On top of that, it introduces attention-based reweighting: tokens that act more like attention hubs receive larger loss weights because mistakes on them are more likely to propagate through later denoising steps.

AGDO-RL extends the same principle to reinforcement learning. It stays within the recent dLLM RL line based on GRPO-style optimization with mean-field approximations, but changes where optimization pressure is applied. Rather than treating randomly masked positions as the optimization target, it organizes token-level credit assignment around attention-induced dependencies and emphasizes attention-critical tokens. Relative to methods like diff-GRPO or wd1, the novelty is less about the RL backbone and more about aligning policy optimization with the model’s intrinsic denoising structure.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental focus is on math and coding reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim being consistent gains over random-masking post-training baselines and over externally imposed decoding orders. The primary analysis is conducted on Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, with validation on LLaDA in the appendix, which suggests the observations are not tied to a single model family.

The more important part is the causal chain in the experiments. The paper first uses MATH-500 to trace attention maps across denoising steps and shows temporal consistency in attention as well as a statistical link between reliance on already-denoised tokens and probability stability. That analysis serves as mechanism evidence for the later algorithm. The downstream comparisons then evaluate random masking, blockwise orders, and left-to-right style orders against attention-guided denoising in both SFT and RL settings. The expected ablations to focus on are: changing only the denoising order while keeping the rest fixed, and removing attention-based token reweighting while preserving the order. If both matter, the gains come from both trajectory alignment and better token-level credit assignment.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark numbers, training-token counts, or RL sampling budgets cannot be stated reliably. The framing in the text suggests the contribution is a robust recipe improvement rather than a one-off large jump.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and the attention analysis section. That is where the paper either lands or does not: if you buy the claim that token dependencies in full-attention dLLMs should be inferred from attention rather than from positional priors, the rest follows naturally. Then read the method section carefully, especially how valid attention scores are defined, whether the denoising order is recomputed dynamically or estimated once, and how the training setup avoids leakage. After that, inspect the AGDO-SFT and AGDO-RL objectives, with special attention to the token reweighting formula and how it fits the mean-field RL approximation.

In the experiments, prioritize: 1) attention visualizations and stability statistics, 2) comparisons across unmasking orders, 3) ablations removing reweighting, and 4) whether the effect holds for both math and coding. For a skim, 30–40 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. For deeper reading, two questions are worth pursuing: whether attention is a causal proxy for dependency or only a correlated signal, and whether the same principle could be pushed into base pretraining rather than only post-training.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 圈里少有的把 attention 结构真正用到训练/去噪 order 的工作；重点看 §3 的 attention 观察和 §4 的 token 加权 RL，别被“SOTA”措辞带跑。
recommendation.en: One of the cleaner dLLM papers that actually uses internal attention to change denoising order and loss weighting; read §3–§4 for the attention observations, ignore the headline SOTA framing.
