paper.abstract: Insertion Language Models (ILMs) offer several advantages over left-to-right generation and mask-based generation. However, existing formulations of insertion-based generation have largely been ad-hoc. In this paper, we derive a diffusion-style denoising objective for ILMs from first principles by formulating the noising process as a continuous-time Markov chain on the space of variable-length sequences. We show that previous formulations of ILMs can be viewed as special cases of this denoising

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是给 Insertion Language Models 一个严谨的生成建模框架。已有 ILM 能在任意位置插入 token，适合规划、子目标补全和相对顺序约束，但训练目标和采样过程多是经验设计。它既不像 AR LM 那样有清楚的左到右似然分解，也不像 diffusion / masked LM 那样有统一的正向加噪、反向去噪和 likelihood lower bound。论文要解决的就是：如何在可变长度序列空间上定义连续时间加噪过程，并由此推导插入式生成的反向过程、训练目标和采样方法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要在建模范式层面。它把 ILM 放进 CTMC diffusion 的统一语言里，使“删除 token 的正向过程”和“插入 token 的反向过程”形成一对概率过程。这比把插入顺序当作启发式策略更干净，也让 ILM 和 D3PM、SEDD、MDLM、LLaDA 一类离散 diffusion / masked generation 工作可以直接比较。贡献量级不是大规模 recipe 或 scaling law，而是给 any-order、可变长度、非左到右语言建模提供了一个可分析的目标函数。对关心 AR 替代范式的人，它的价值在于明确了 ILM 为什么不同于 masked diffusion：ILM 不需要把长度问题塞进 PAD token 预测，而是把长度增长作为反向 CTMC 的一部分来建模。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从连续时间马尔可夫链出发，把状态空间定义为所有可变长度 token 序列。正向 noising process 从真实序列开始，以时间相关速率随机删除 token，最终到达一个参考分布。反向生成过程则从参考分布出发，通过若干 jump 不断插入 token，直到得到完整序列。关键公式是 CTMC 的时间反转率：反向 rate 由正向 rate 和时间边缘分布之比决定；真实边缘不可得时，用参数化的反向 rate 近似，并推导数据 log-likelihood 的 evidence lower bound。论文提出两类参数化。第一类是 joint insertion parameterization：模型一次预测一个插入事件，即插入位置和词表 token 的联合分布，同时建模剩余长度或 length-to-go。这个版本更接近经典 insertion transformer，也更容易解释单步插入决策。第二类是 factorized / independent parameterization：把多个插入维度近似独立建模，从而允许一次采样多个插入事件，减少纯单 token 插入带来的采样步数。这个版本更接近 masked diffusion 的并行生成能力，但仍保留 ILM 的可变长度序列建模。与既有 ILM 的区别在于，插入顺序、训练目标和采样规则不再是单独指定的工程选择，而是从正向删除过程和反向 CTMC 的 ELBO 中导出。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成规划任务和语言建模任务。合成规划实验主要检验 ILM 的结构优势：当任务要求先生成子目标、再补全中间步骤，或需要遵守相对顺序约束时，左到右 AR 模型会被生成顺序限制，masked diffusion 又会受到定长 block 和 PAD 建模影响；CTMC-ILM 保留任意位置插入能力，因此在这类任务上优于 AR 和 masked diffusion 基线。语言建模实验显示，diffusion-style ILM 相比已有经验式 ILM 和 MDM 有更稳定的表现，并能接近左到右 LM。需要注意，实验更像是范式验证，而不是大规模预训练结论；参数规模、数据规模和绝对困惑度需要结合论文表格核对，不应直接外推到 trillion-token 训练。消融的核心看点是两类反向 rate 参数化、单插入与多插入采样、长度建模方式，以及采样步数对质量和速度的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一，CTMC background 和 likelihood lower bound 推导，这是理解整篇工作的基础，重点看时间反转 rate、正向删除过程如何诱导反向插入过程。第二，noising process 与 reverse-rate parameterization，尤其是 joint insertion 和 independent insertion 两个版本的差异：前者更精确，后者更适合并行采样。第三，采样算法和计算复杂度部分，重点看如何在可变长度状态空间中避免枚举所有序列，以及如何把连续时间过程离散化为可训练、可采样的算法。实验部分可重点看合成规划任务的设置，因为它更清楚地暴露 ILM 相对 AR 和 MDM 的归纳偏置。附录中的 ELBO 推导、符号表和实现细节值得跟着公式走一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a missing probabilistic foundation for Insertion Language Models. ILMs generate by inserting tokens at arbitrary positions, which makes them useful for planning, infilling, and tasks with relative-order constraints. Prior ILM objectives and samplers were mostly heuristic. The central question is how to define a principled noising process over variable-length sequences and derive the insertion generator, training loss, and sampler from that process.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is conceptual and objective-level rather than a large-scale training recipe. It recasts insertion-based generation as a continuous-time Markov chain diffusion process, where forward corruption deletes tokens and reverse generation inserts them. This gives ILMs a common language with discrete diffusion and masked language models, while preserving a key advantage over masked diffusion: sequence length is generated through insertions rather than represented indirectly through PAD tokens. For pretraining research, the value is in making any-order, variable-length language modeling easier to analyze and compare against AR, D3PM-style, SEDD-style, and masked diffusion approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: The state space is the countable set of all finite token sequences. The forward process starts from a data sequence and randomly drops tokens with a time-dependent rate. The reverse process starts from a reference distribution and grows the sequence through insertion jumps. Using CTMC time reversal, the ideal reverse rate can be written in terms of the forward rate and time marginals; since the marginals are unknown, the work parameterizes the reverse rate with Transformer models and derives an evidence lower bound on the data likelihood. Two reverse parameterizations are proposed. The first models a single insertion event, including the joint distribution over insertion position and vocabulary item, together with the remaining length. This connects directly to earlier insertion transformers. The second uses an independent, per-dimension factorization that allows multiple insertions in one sampling step, trading exactness for parallel generation. The main difference from earlier ILMs is that the insertion order, denoising objective, and sampler are derived from a single CTMC construction rather than specified separately.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include a synthetic planning task and language modeling. The planning task is the more diagnostic setting: when generation benefits from placing subgoals first and filling intermediate steps later, left-to-right models are restricted by their order, while masked diffusion has to handle length through fixed blocks and PAD prediction. The CTMC-based ILM keeps the flexible insertion bias and outperforms AR and masked-diffusion baselines in this setting. On language modeling, the diffusion-style ILM is reported to improve over earlier ILM and MDM variants and to be competitive with left-to-right modeling. The evidence should be read as a controlled validation of the modeling framework, not as a scaling result. The most important ablations are the two reverse-rate parameterizations, single-step versus multi-insertion sampling, explicit length modeling, and the quality-speed tradeoff as the number of sampling steps changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the CTMC preliminaries and the likelihood lower-bound derivation carefully; they contain the real modeling contribution. Then focus on the forward deletion process and the two reverse-rate parameterizations, especially the distinction between joint insertion and factorized multi-insertion. The sampling and computational sections are also important because variable-length sequence spaces can easily lead to intractable enumeration if the process is not parameterized carefully. In the experiments, prioritize the synthetic planning setup and its ablations, since they expose the inductive bias of insertion generation more clearly than aggregate language-modeling metrics. The appendices on notation, ELBO derivation, and implementation details are worth checking for anyone considering follow-up work.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法推导；它把 ILM 从技巧整理成 CTMC 去噪框架，会影响非 AR LM 的对照实验设计。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation; it turns ILMs from a bag of tricks into a CTMC denoising framework and affects non-AR LM ablation design.

paper.title: Forward-Free Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising, offering a powerful alternative to autoregressive generation. However, discrete language spaces lack a natural neighborhood structure for defining effective perturbations, so some artificial corruption schemes are proposed in the forward process. Such prescribed forward processes often produce states that are mathematically convenient but misaligned with drafts and errors encountered during generation, resulting in degraded sam

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是离散 diffusion language model 里最难绕开的设计问题：forward corruption path 很难定义。图像 diffusion 可以用高斯噪声，因为连续空间有自然邻域；文本 token 没有这种几何结构，随机替换、mask、absorbing state 或离散转移核都会人为制造一条中间分布路径。训练时学到的是反转这条路径，但推理时模型遇到的往往是自己生成的草稿和错误，两者不匹配会损害生成质量。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 diffusion LM 的核心从“设计噪声过程”转向“学习分布递归修正”。这对 masked diffusion、SEDD/MDLM/LLaDA 一类方法都有参考意义：离散文本建模未必需要先规定一个 token 级扰动几何，而可以让模型生成的 draft 形成中间状态。贡献量级属于建模范式和训练-推理对齐层面的改动，不是单纯 decoding trick。不过论文目前只展示 4B、10B token continued-pretraining 规模，离真正验证 scaling 行为还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: FReDA 的核心做法是去掉手工 forward process，把 diffusion LM 写成 recursive distribution refinement。模型先从一个初始 draft distribution 产生候选序列，再学习把当前 draft 修正得更接近数据分布。中间状态不来自预设噪声 schedule，而来自模型早期或不成熟生成器的输出，因此训练分布更接近推理时会看到的错误类型。论文给出两种实例化：第一是 self-refinement，模型直接修改自己的草稿；第二是 stochastic best-of-N refinement，并行提出多个候选序列，再用额外 score head 选择较好的候选。这个设计和传统 D3PM/absorbing-mask diffusion 的差别在于，后者先定义 q(x_t|x_0)，再训练反向转移；FReDA 让 sampler 自身诱导中间分布路径，使 refinement step 的难度随模型能力变化，而不是由固定噪声强度控制。
summary.experiments: 论文训练了 FReDA-4B，使用 10B token continued-pretraining corpus。这个预算小于若干 diffusion baseline。评测覆盖 general knowledge、math reasoning 和 code generation，并聚焦 sub-8B 模型。结果显示，FReDA-4B 在四个推理和代码 benchmark 上超过 7B-8B diffusion base models，绝对提升约 5%-15%；在通用知识任务上保持竞争力。效率上，FReDA 给出更好的 quality-speed Pareto trade-off：达到相近准确率需要更少 forward passes，每次 forward 生成的 token 更多，平均加速约 1.5-1.8 倍。额外分析表明，增加 refinement iterations 能带来比较稳定的收益，说明推理时计算可以转化为质量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30-45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 discrete forward process 的批评，这部分讲清了为什么文本 diffusion 不能直接照搬连续噪声。然后看方法里 recursive distribution refinement 的形式化定义，重点比较它和显式 q(x_t|x_0) 的区别。self-refinement 与 stochastic best-of-N refinement 是实现层面的关键，score head 如何训练和使用值得细看。实验部分重点看四类信息：4B/10B token 的训练设置、和 LLaDA/MDLM/其他 7B-8B diffusion baselines 的公平性、refinement iteration 的消融、quality-speed 曲线。需要保留一个疑问：continued-pretraining 规模较小，结果能否扩展到更大 token budget 和更大参数量还没有被充分证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central weakness of discrete diffusion language models: the forward corruption path is hard to define. Gaussian perturbations work naturally in continuous domains because the space has a meaningful local geometry. Token spaces do not. Masking, random replacement, absorbing states, or hand-crafted transition kernels impose artificial intermediate distributions. The reverse model is trained to invert those distributions, but generation-time drafts contain model-specific errors that need not resemble the prescribed noising process.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the shift from designing a corruption process to learning recursive distribution refinement. This is relevant to masked diffusion LMs, SEDD-like models, MDLM, and LLaDA-style systems. The paper suggests that discrete language diffusion may not need a token-level neighborhood model; intermediate states can instead be induced by the model's own drafts. The contribution is at the modeling-objective and train-inference-alignment level, not just a sampler modification. The evidence is still limited to a 4B model with 10B tokens of continued pretraining, so the scaling behavior remains open.
summary_en.technical_approach: FReDA removes the hand-designed forward process and formulates diffusion language modeling as recursive distribution refinement. A model produces draft sequences, and the learned transition improves those drafts toward the data distribution. The implicit intermediate states are generated by premature or current versions of the model rather than by an externally specified noise schedule. The paper instantiates this idea in two ways. Self-refinement directly revises the model's own draft. Stochastic best-of-N refinement samples multiple candidate sequences in parallel and uses an additional scoring head to select the most promising one. This differs from D3PM or absorbing-mask diffusion, where q(x_t|x_0) is specified first and the model learns its reverse. In FReDA, the sampler induces the distributional path, and the difficulty of each refinement step adapts to the model's expressive capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The reported model is FReDA-4B trained with a 10B-token continued-pretraining corpus, smaller than the budgets used by several diffusion baselines. Evaluation covers general knowledge, mathematical reasoning, and code generation in the sub-8B regime. FReDA-4B outperforms 7B-8B diffusion base models on four reasoning and coding benchmarks, with absolute gains of roughly 5-15%, while remaining competitive on general knowledge tasks. On efficiency, it reaches a stronger quality-speed trade-off: fewer forward passes are needed for comparable accuracy, more tokens are produced per forward pass, and the average speedup is reported as 1.5-1.8x. Additional analyses show consistent gains as refinement computation increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30-45 minutes. Start with the Introduction, especially the argument against fixed corruption paths in discrete token space. Then read the formal definition of recursive distribution refinement and compare it with methods that explicitly define q(x_t|x_0). The two implementation choices, self-refinement and stochastic best-of-N refinement, are the key method details; the training and usage of the score head deserve attention. In the experiments, focus on four points: the 4B/10B-token setup, fairness against LLaDA/MDLM-like 7B-8B diffusion baselines, refinement-iteration ablations, and the quality-speed curve. The main open question is whether the approach continues to hold under much larger pretraining budgets and model sizes.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM范式的重要突破——消除前向过程设计是对整个离散扩散建模思路的挑战；§3理论推导和§4实验部分值得预训练研究员细读，关注与AR范式的对比视角。
recommendation.en: An important diffusion LM breakthrough—eliminating the forward process challenges the entire discrete diffusion paradigm. §3 theoretical derivation and §4 experiments are worth reading for pretraining researchers, especially for contrast with AR paradigms.

paper.title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
paper.abstract: Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introd

summary.core_problem: 现有离散视觉语言动作（VLA）模型要么采用自回归生成动作导致推理延迟高，要么用并行解码但缺乏token依赖建模，忽略动作轨迹的固有时间结构。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了时间分块离散扩散与跨块自回归结合的混合生成范式，平衡了动作生成的推理速度与时间连贯性。
summary.technical_approach: 将动作序列划分为时间块，块内执行掩码离散扩散实现并行解码，块间维持自回归建模时序依赖，统一了两种生成机制的优势。
summary.experiments: 未明确给出模型参数量与具体基线数值，仅说明设计在时间连贯性和推理速度上均有提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models either use autoregressive action generation with high inference latency, or parallel decoding without explicit token dependency modeling, ignoring the inherent temporal structure of action trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a hybrid generation paradigm combining temporal block-wise discrete diffusion and cross-block autoregression, balancing inference speed and temporal coherence of action generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Partition action sequences into temporal blocks, perform masked discrete diffusion within each block for parallel decoding, and maintain autoregressive modeling across blocks to capture temporal dependencies, unifying the advantages of both generation mechanisms.
summary_en.experiments: No explicit model parameter count or specific baseline metrics are provided; the design is stated to achieve improvements in both temporal coherence and inference speed.

recommendation.zh: 块级扩散与跨块自回归的混合生成设计可参考，仅需看方法部分的分块机制即可。
recommendation.en: The hybrid block-wise diffusion and cross-block autoregression design is worth referencing; only review the block partitioning mechanism in the method section.

paper.title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
paper.abstract: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensio

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散模型的可控生成现有方案存在局限：分类器/无分类器引导、微调等方法需要额外训练阶段，泛化性差且计算成本高；现有即插即用引导方案受离散空间不可微特性限制，存在梯度不稳定、计算开销大、引导效果有限的问题。
summary.importance: 为离散扩散模型提供了一种无需重新训练的通用可控生成范式，对离散扩散在语言、生物序列等领域的落地应用有直接参考价值；其利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理、直接修正logit的思路对离散生成模型的引导技术设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出梯度感知logit修正（GILC）即插即用引导框架：1. 将引导任务重构为估计中间状态的预期未来奖励值函数的梯度，复用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理进行值估计，无需额外训练组件。2. 结合Gumbel-Softmax和直通估计器维持离散空间的梯度流，同时引入无雅可比更新机制直接修正干净预测logit，解决离散空间梯度不稳定问题。3. 建立与策略梯度的形式化关联，让框架可以同时处理可微和不可微奖励函数。
summary.experiments: 在DNA序列设计、蛋白质序列工程、多模态分子生成三个跨领域任务上进行验证，GILC在样本质量和计算效率上均显著优于其他无训练的离散扩散引导方法，同时性能与基于微调的方法相当。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分的现有方法局限分析、方法部分的logit修正机制和策略梯度关联推导，附录A的相关工作对比可按需查阅，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing controllable generation methods for discrete diffusion models have clear limitations: classifier/classifier-free guidance and fine-tuning require additional training stages, leading to poor generalizability and high computational cost; current plug-and-play guidance methods suffer from gradient instability, prohibitive computational overhead and limited steering effectiveness due to the inherent non-differentiability of discrete spaces.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a general training-free controllable generation paradigm for discrete diffusion models, with direct reference value for practical applications of discrete diffusion in domains like language and biological sequences. The ideas of reusing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy and directly correcting logits offer inspiration for the design of guidance techniques for discrete generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Gradient-Informed Logit Correction (GILC) plug-and-play guidance framework is proposed: 1. The guidance task is reframed as estimating the gradient of the expected future reward value function from intermediate states, reusing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy for value estimation without additional training components. 2. The Gumbel-Softmax trick and Straight-Through estimator are combined to maintain gradient flow in discrete spaces, while a Jacobian-free update mechanism is introduced to directly correct clean prediction logits, resolving the gradient instability issue in discrete spaces. 3. A formal connection to policy gradients is established, enabling the framework to handle both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across three cross-domain tasks: DNA sequence design, protein sequence engineering, and multimodal molecular generation. GILC significantly outperforms other training-free discrete diffusion guidance methods in both sample quality and computational efficiency, and matches the performance of fine-tuning-based approaches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of limitations of existing methods in the introduction, the logit correction mechanism and policy gradient connection derivation in the method section. The related work comparison in Appendix A can be consulted as needed. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散即插即用引导的设计思路对研究diffusion LM推理控制有参考价值，重点看§3的无雅可比校正机制。
recommendation.en: The plug-and-play guidance design for discrete diffusion is informative for diffusion LM inference control research; focus on the Jacobian-free correction mechanism in §3.

paper.title: Adapting Diffusion Language Models for Lossless Pixel-Level Image Transmission
paper.abstract: Lossless pixel-level image transmission is a fundamental regime beyond semantic communications, because exact recovery requires both accurate symbol probability modeling and reliable delivery over noisy channels. This paper proposes DDM-SSCC, a discrete-diffusion-model-based separate source-channel coding framework for lossless image transmission. Different from raster-order autoregressive coding, the proposed source codec adapts a diffusion language model to pixel-token restoration and performs

summary.core_problem: 无损像素级图像传输需要精准的符号概率建模和噪声信道下的可靠传输，现有基于自回归编码的方法存在编码效率不足的问题。
summary.importance: 属于通信领域的工程创新，将扩散语言模型迁移应用到图像源信道编码，提供了离散扩散模型在非生成任务的新应用场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DDM-SSCC离散扩散基源信道分离编码框架，将扩散语言模型适配到像素token恢复，基于双向注意力实现同步反向算术编码，单步可编码多个掩码token；引入Halton引导的去噪策略衔接生成式掩码去噪与无损算术编码的gap。
summary.experiments: 在标准图像数据集上测试无损压缩率和噪声信道下的传输恢复准确率，与自回归编码基线对比编码效率提升。
summary.authors_note: 无法从公开信息确认作者所属机构及知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Lossless pixel-level image transmission requires accurate symbol probability modeling and reliable delivery over noisy channels, while existing autoregressive coding methods suffer from limited coding efficiency.
summary_en.importance: An engineering innovation in the communications domain, adapting diffusion language models for image source-channel coding and demonstrating a new application scenario for discrete diffusion models outside generative tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DDM-SSCC, a discrete-diffusion-based separate source-channel coding framework that adapts diffusion language models for pixel-token restoration, performs synchronized reverse arithmetic coding under bidirectional attention to encode multiple masked tokens per denoising step, and introduces Halton-guided denoising to bridge the gap between generative masked denoising and lossless arithmetic coding.

paper.title: Fast-dLLM++: Fréchet Profile Decoding for Faster Diffusion LLM Inference

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的一个很具体但关键的问题：在并行解码时，哪些 masked 位置可以在同一步里一起“提交”而不明显伤害质量。Fast-dLLM 已经给出过基于置信度的并行提交规则，但它把候选集合压缩成“最弱那个 token 的置信度”来做决策，相当于用最坏情况代表整个集合。论文指出这在真实解码里过于保守，因为不同位置的置信度往往高度异质：少数位置几乎确定，少数位置只是中等确定。如果仍按 weakest-token 规则裁剪，就会白白损失可并行性，导致 diffusion LM 理论上的并行优势在实际推理里兑现不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是训练范式创新，而是 diffusion LM 走向可用推理路径上的一块基础拼图。价值主要有三层。第一，它把“并行提交”从经验启发式推进到更严格的分布无关证书，说明在只知道边缘置信度、不了解位置间依赖结构时，还能做到多保守、多激进。第二，它直接服务于 diffusion/MDLM 这条非 AR 语言建模路线的现实瓶颈：如果推理速度始终被保守提交规则卡住，再好的训练目标也很难形成系统优势。第三，它给出一个很清楚的结论：异质置信度不是噪声，而是可利用的结构信号。这个判断对后续做 profile-aware decoding、学习式提交策略、甚至训练时显式塑造置信度分布，都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是 training-free 的，对已有 diffusion LLM 直接替换提交规则。核心做法叫 Fréchet profile decoding。设当前一步有若干 masked 位置，每个位置都有模型给出的 greedy token 及其边缘置信度。Fast-dLLM 的 factor rule 只看 top-n 候选里最小的那个置信度 c(n)，接受条件形如 (n+1)(1-c(n)) < f，本质是把所有已选 token 当成同一置信度处理。Fast-dLLM++ 则保留完整排序后的置信度 profile (c(1), c(2), ..., c(n))，对每个前缀大小 n 计算两个量：一是所有 n 个 greedy token 同时正确的联合概率下界 Ln；二是任意竞争 tuple 的概率上界 Un。若 Ln - Un > δ，就认为这个前缀足够安全，可以整体提交，并选择满足条件的最大前缀。

这里的关键不是换了一个经验分数，而是用了 Fréchet 型界来构造“只依赖边缘概率、对依赖关系最坏情况仍成立”的保守证书。论文证明了：在没有额外位置依赖信息时，这类 Fréchet 下界已经是 distribution-free 场景下最强的保守证书之一；也就是说，只靠边缘置信度，理论上很难再做得更强。另一个重要点是它和旧规则的关系。作者证明在 equal-confidence 特例下，新规则会退化回 Fast-dLLM 的 factor decoding，因此它不是另起炉灶，而是对 homogeneous-confidence 假设的严格推广。

论文还给出 heterogeneity bonus 分解，解释为什么 profile-aware 规则能多提交 token：当 profile 前部有一批极高置信度位置时，联合正确事件的下界不会像 weakest-token 近似那样被末尾中等置信度位置完全拖垮，因此可接受前缀会更长。工程上它兼容 KV cache 和不同 cache regime，不需要额外 verifier 或 drafter，这一点和 AR 里的 speculative decoding 路线不同。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖文本推理、代码和多模态推理，模型包括 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-v0-Base-7B，以及多模态版本 LLaDA-V；任务包括 GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MBPP。论文主结果不是单点精度，而是 accuracy-throughput frontier：在相同质量下获得更高吞吐，或在相同吞吐下保持更好准确率。按照文中描述，Fast-dLLM++ 在多种 generation length 和 cache 设置下都优于原始 Fast-dLLM 的 threshold/factor 规则，收益在置信度分布更异质、生成更长、并行空间更大的场景更明显。

消融的重点有三类。第一，equal-confidence 与 heterogeneous-confidence 对比，验证理论上新规则在同质情形退化为旧规则，而在异质情形出现额外并行收益。第二，margin 参数 δ、不同 cache regime、不同 commit size 的敏感性分析，用来展示速度和质量之间的可调边界。第三，多任务与多模型泛化，说明收益不是某个特定 diffusion LM 或某个 benchmark 的偶然现象。给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字，因此不适合编造具体提升百分比；但从实验组织看，作者是在用“前沿曲线整体右移”而不是单个点胜负来论证方法有效，这对解码论文是更合理的证据形式。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 和方法总览图，明确它到底替换了 Fast-dLLM 的哪一部分，以及为什么 weakest-token 假设会保守。第二，看理论部分里关于 Theorem 4.1 和 strongest distribution-free certificate 的论证，这决定了方法不是拍脑袋调规则，而是在“只知道边缘置信度”这个信息约束下尽量做满。第三，看 heterogeneity-bonus decomposition 和主实验的 frontier 图，理解收益来自哪里，而不是只记住“更快”。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：Introduction → 提交规则定义 → equal-confidence 退化关系 → 主实验图。预计 25–35 分钟可以把主要思想读清。若想深挖，重点看 Fréchet 下界如何构造、Un 如何定义，以及这些界在真实模型校准误差存在时是否仍稳健。这也是后续研究最值得追问的地方：当前证书只利用边缘置信度，若能引入轻量依赖估计，是否还能继续放宽提交条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central inference bottleneck in diffusion LLMs: deciding which masked positions can be committed in parallel at each denoising step without hurting generation quality too much. Fast-dLLM already introduced confidence-guided commit rules, but its theory collapses a candidate set to the weakest selected token. That is a worst-case homogeneous-confidence approximation. The authors argue this is unnecessarily conservative because real confidence profiles are highly heterogeneous: a few positions are near-certain while others are only moderately confident. If the whole set is judged by the weakest token, useful parallelism is left unused.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for the viability of diffusion-style language modeling as a competing paradigm to autoregressive decoding. Its contribution is mainly on the inference side, yet the implication is broader: if diffusion LMs cannot cash out their parallel-generation advantage at decode time, architectural or objective-level gains will not translate into system-level wins. The paper also makes a more general point that confidence heterogeneity is exploitable structure rather than nuisance. That idea could later feed back into training, calibration, or learned commit policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Fast-dLLM++ is a training-free replacement for the commit rule used during diffusion decoding. Instead of using only the weakest confidence among the top-n candidate positions, it keeps the full sorted confidence profile (c(1), c(2), ..., c(n)). For each candidate prefix of size n, it computes a Fréchet lower bound L_n on the probability that all n marginal greedy tokens are jointly correct, and an upper bound U_n on the probability of any competing tuple. The decoder commits the largest prefix satisfying L_n - U_n > delta, where delta is a safety margin.

The key technical move is that the certificate is built from marginal confidences only, with no explicit dependence model across positions. The paper proves that this yields a heterogeneous-confidence sufficient condition under which greedy parallel decoding matches the true joint greedy decision. It further argues that, without additional dependence information, the Fréchet-based certificate is the strongest conservative distribution-free guarantee available from marginals alone. This is the main theoretical claim.

Another useful result is the reduction to the previous rule: in the equal-confidence case, the new criterion collapses exactly to Fast-dLLM factor decoding. So the method is not a disconnected heuristic; it is a strict generalization of the homogeneous-confidence analysis. The heterogeneity-bonus decomposition then explains when gains appear: if the confidence profile has a strong head and a weaker tail, the full-profile certificate can still justify committing a larger set, whereas the weakest-token rule gets dominated by the tail. Operationally, the method remains compatible with KV caching and does not require a separate drafter or verifier, unlike speculative decoding for AR models.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans reasoning, math, code, and multimodal reasoning. Models include LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-v0-Base-7B, and LLaDA-V. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MBPP. The main empirical claim is not a single-point accuracy gain but a better accuracy-throughput frontier: at matched quality, Fast-dLLM++ achieves higher throughput; at matched throughput, it preserves better accuracy than prior threshold/factor rules.

The ablations are structured around the theory. First, the paper contrasts homogeneous and heterogeneous confidence settings, showing that the new rule reduces to the old one in the equal-confidence regime and gains only when profile heterogeneity exists. Second, it studies the effect of the margin parameter, cache regimes, and generation length, which clarifies the speed-quality trade-off. Third, it tests multiple models and tasks to argue the effect is not benchmark-specific. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables, so it is better not to invent exact deltas. Still, the experimental design is appropriate for a decoding paper because it focuses on frontier shifts rather than isolated wins.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main method figure to understand exactly what part of Fast-dLLM is being replaced and why the weakest-token abstraction is too conservative. Second, read the theorem establishing the sufficient condition and the claim about the strongest distribution-free certificate. That is the difference between a principled decoding rule and another heuristic. Third, inspect the heterogeneity-bonus analysis and the main frontier plots to see where the practical gains come from.

A good reading order is: Introduction -> commit rule definition -> reduction to the equal-confidence case -> main experimental figures. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main idea. If reading more deeply, pay attention to how L_n and U_n are constructed and ask how robust the certificate is under calibration error in model confidences. That is likely the most important follow-up question.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟踪 AR 之外的 LM 范式，这篇该看；先盯速度-质量折中表，若只省步数不省 wall-clock，就别高估它。
recommendation.en: If you track non-AR LM paradigms, this is worth a look; focus on the speed-quality tradeoff table first—if it cuts steps but not wall-clock, do not overrate it.

paper.title: Decoding in Order-Agnostic Language Models: Chain-Rule Deviation and Uniform Spreading
paper.abstract: Order-agnostic language models (OALMs), including discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), are trained to predict masked tokens under arbitrary conditioning sets, allowing sequences to be generated or scored under arbitrary reveal orders at inference time. In LLaDA-2.1, we report three findings. First, the learned conditionals are not exact factorizations of a coherent joint distribution: changing only the reveal order shifts target log-likelihood by up to 0.49 nats/token, so likelihood alone

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 order-agnostic language model，尤其是离散 diffusion LM，在“可以按任意顺序揭示 token”这一能力下，解码顺序到底意味着什么。作者抓住了两个核心问题。第一，这类模型学到的条件分布未必来自同一个一致的联合分布，因此同一目标序列仅仅改变 reveal order，累计 log-likelihood 就会变化，链式分解不再路径无关。第二，即便总概率相近，不同顺序把“置信度预算”分配到各步的方式不同，而 greedy decoding 的成败往往由最薄弱的一步决定。于是，只看总 logP 不够，还要看每一步置信度是否均匀展开。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式的价值很直接。很多人把 any-order / diffusion LM 的推断顺序当成一个工程层面的 decoding trick，但这篇文章说明，顺序本身暴露了模型训练目标的内在不一致性，也决定了生成可靠性的另一条轴。对预训练研究来说，这有两层启发。其一，若一个 OALM 的条件分布不满足 chain-rule consistency，那么用不同 reveal order 做打分、重排、偏好比较时，数值本身已经混入路径伪影，不能直接当作“同一 joint 的不同分解”。其二，训练目标若只鼓励局部条件预测，却不约束不同路径之间的一致性，推断时就会出现预算分配不均，导致某些顺序更容易在局部 argmax 上失手。这个问题和 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order AR 都相关，属于建模范式层面的诊断，而不是某个 benchmark 上的小技巧。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成经验诊断和一个小理论结果。经验部分，作者在 LLaDA-2.1-mini 上固定模型与目标序列，只改变 reveal order，比较路径上的逐步条件概率 q_t(π)=pθ(x*_{π(t)}|R_{t-1},c)。如果这些条件分布真来自同一个联合分布，那么按 chain rule，∑t log q_t 应该与顺序无关。作者发现并非如此，说明模型不是一个严格一致的 joint estimator。

理论部分提出了 uniform-spreading theorem。作者把目标序列恢复看成一串局部 argmax 决策：每一步不仅要让正确 token 概率高，还要高过局部竞争者。若固定总预算 P=∏t q_t，那么最有利的情况不是把高置信度集中在少数步，而是让每一步都尽量均匀，即 q_t=P^{1/n}。偏离这种均匀分布的结构性代价可以由 Var(log q_t) 描述。于是，logP 衡量总预算，Var(log q_t) 衡量预算分配是否平滑，二者构成互补诊断轴。

在解码策略分析上，作者比较了 Forced-AR、Random、以及 confidence-first 的 Max-prob 和 Top-margin。一个有意思的发现是，CF 虽然名义上是 order-agnostic，但在内容 token 上走出的 reveal path 与严格 left-to-right 很接近；它的主要偏离出现在短答案场景，会触发 tail-EOS cascade。这解释了为什么一些看似“非 AR”的顺序策略，实际行为却接近 AR。
summary.experiments:
关键实验集中在 LLaDA-2.1-mini 和 C4 片段上。作者从 1,000 个随机 C4 样本中切出 prefix 和 target continuation，固定目标序列后比较不同 reveal order 的路径分数。结果显示，仅改变顺序，logP/n 最多可偏移 0.49 nats/token。这个量级已经远超可以忽略的数值误差，足以说明 learned conditionals 不是同一个 joint 的精确分解。

在生成层面，作者比较多种 one-token-per-step 策略。Structured 策略——Forced-AR、Max-prob、Top-margin——在外部 perplexity 上相近，但 Var(log q_t) 明显低于 Random。作者进一步做 reveal-order analysis，发现 Max-prob 和 Top-margin 的非 EOS 内容路径与 L2R 高度接近，因此它们表现相似并不奇怪；差异主要来自短答案任务中 CF 更容易提前形成 EOS 尾部连锁。

下游验证覆盖 HellaSwag、CMath、MMLU-Pro、IFEval。论文的重点不是刷新绝对分数，而是看 correctness 与方差轴的关系。结论是：较低的 Var(log q_t) 与正确生成稳定相关，而且这种相关性不能简单归因于 Random 整体太差，因为在多种策略和样本层面都能看到同样趋势。换句话说，confidence trace 的平滑程度确实携带了生成可靠性信息。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看三部分。第一是引言前半段，作者把 OALM、dLLM、reveal order、路径分数的定义讲得比较清楚。第二是 §4.2，那里给出最关键的 chain-rule deviation 结果：同一目标序列换顺序后 logP/n 可漂移约 0.5 nats/token。第三是 Theorem 3.1 及其解释，不必逐行推导，但要理解为什么 greedy decoding 更怕单步瓶颈，因此 Var(log q_t) 会成为有意义的诊断量。

如果只有 20 分钟，建议读法是：Introduction → Theorem 3.1 的结论和图示 → §4.2 的固定序列打分实验 → §4.3 的 reveal-order analysis → §4.4 的 benchmark 相关性结果。阅读时要注意作者并没有证明“低方差一定带来更高任务分数”，而是提出一个比总 logP 更贴近解码可靠性的补充指标。值得继续深挖的点包括：训练时能否显式加入 path consistency 约束；以及在更大规模 dLLM 上，这种 0.49 nats/token 的路径漂移会缩小还是放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what decoding order really means in order-agnostic language models, especially discrete diffusion LMs that can reveal tokens in arbitrary orders. It isolates two issues. First, the learned conditionals need not correspond to a single coherent joint distribution, so the cumulative log-likelihood of the same target sequence can change when only the reveal order changes. Second, even when total probability is similar, decoding reliability depends on how confidence is distributed across steps, because greedy generation can fail at a single weak step. So total logP is not enough; one also needs to inspect the shape of the confidence trace.
summary_en.importance: This matters directly for alternative language-modeling paradigms. Reveal order in diffusion or any-order LMs is often treated as a decoding choice, but the paper shows that it also exposes a modeling inconsistency inherited from training. For pretraining research, there are two concrete implications. First, if an OALM violates chain-rule consistency, then likelihood comparisons across reveal orders are contaminated by path artifacts and should not be interpreted as different factorizations of the same joint. Second, if training only teaches local conditional prediction without enforcing cross-path consistency, inference can allocate confidence unevenly across steps, making some orders much more brittle under greedy decoding. That is a modeling issue, not just a decoding heuristic issue.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper combines an empirical diagnostic with a compact theoretical result. Empirically, it fixes the model and target sequence in LLaDA-2.1-mini, varies only the reveal order, and evaluates the pathwise conditional probabilities q_t(π)=pθ(x*_{π(t)}|R_{t-1},c). If these conditionals came from a coherent joint distribution, the chain rule would make the sum of log q_t invariant to order. The paper shows that this invariance fails in practice.

The theoretical contribution is the uniform-spreading theorem. The authors frame target recovery as a sequence of local argmax decisions. At each step, success depends not only on the target probability q_t itself, but on whether it wins against local competitors. Holding the total budget P=∏t q_t fixed, recoverability is uniquely maximized when confidence is spread uniformly across steps, q_t=P^(1/n). The structural penalty for uneven allocation is captured by Var(log q_t). This yields two complementary diagnostics: logP measures total confidence budget, while Var(log q_t) measures how efficiently a reveal order distributes that budget.

The paper then analyzes several decoding strategies: Forced-AR, Random, and confidence-first variants such as Max-prob and Top-margin. A notable empirical finding is that confidence-first decoding, although order-agnostic in principle, follows reveal paths that are close to left-to-right on content tokens. Its main deviation appears in short-answer settings, where it can trigger a tail-EOS cascade.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments use LLaDA-2.1-mini on fixed target continuations from C4. The authors sample 1,000 random C4 examples, split each into a prefix and target continuation, and compare path scores under different reveal orders. The headline result is that changing only the order can shift logP/n by as much as 0.49 nats per token. That is far beyond numerical noise and is strong evidence that the learned conditionals are not exact factorizations of one coherent joint distribution.

For generation behavior, the paper compares one-token-per-step strategies. Structured strategies—Forced-AR, Max-prob, and Top-margin—show similar external perplexity, but substantially lower Var(log q_t) than Random. Reveal-order analysis explains why: Max-prob and Top-margin traverse content-token paths that are very close to strict left-to-right decoding, so their behavior is much less exotic than the order-agnostic label suggests. The main difference comes from short-answer prompts, where confidence-first rules can exploit a tail-EOS cascade.

Downstream validation covers HellaSwag, CMath, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval. The point is not headline benchmark gains, but the relationship between correctness and the variance axis. Lower Var(log q_t) is consistently associated with correct generations, and the pattern is not reducible to Random simply being weak overall. That supports the claim that confidence-trace smoothness carries information about decoding reliability beyond total path likelihood.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, the early introduction, which clearly defines OALMs, dLLMs, reveal order, and pathwise scoring. Second, §4.2, which contains the most important empirical result: logP/n for the same target can drift by about 0.5 nats/token across reveal orders. Third, Theorem 3.1 and its interpretation. You do not need every derivation detail, but you should understand why greedy decoding is vulnerable to a single low-confidence bottleneck, which makes Var(log q_t) a meaningful diagnostic.

If you have about 20 minutes, read in this order: introduction, the statement and intuition of Theorem 3.1, the fixed-sequence scoring experiment in §4.2, the reveal-order analysis in §4.3, and the benchmark correlation results in §4.4. One subtle point to keep in mind is that the paper does not claim low variance alone guarantees better task performance. The claim is narrower and more useful: variance is a complementary signal that captures decoding reliability better than total logP alone. The natural follow-up questions are whether training can explicitly enforce path consistency, and whether the observed 0.49 nats/token order drift shrinks or grows at larger dLLM scales.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看 dLLM 的 likelihood 和 decode order；先看 chain-rule deviation 和 uniform-spreading theorem，两处都在修正“order-agnostic 就等于 joint-consistent”的直觉。
recommendation.en: This changes how you should read dLLM likelihoods and decode orders; start with the chain-rule deviation result and the uniform-spreading theorem, both of which push against the easy 'order-agnostic implies joint-consistent' intuition.

paper.title: Adaptive Order Policies for Masked Diffusion
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion models have seen great success in capturing data distributions over discrete sequences in domains such as text and proteins. These models generate data by iteratively unmasking tokens starting from a fully masked sequence, with the unmasking order typically chosen at random or using a heuristic based on denoiser probabilities. In this work, we propose a scheme for learning the unmasking order using an additional lightweight policy network on top of a diffusion model. Our propose

summary.core_problem: 在 Masked Diffusion Models 中，如何学习一个比随机或启发式更好的 unmasking 顺序（生成顺序）？
summary.importance: 针对离散 diffusion LM 的核心痛点（生成顺序），提出了一种可学习的自适应策略，挑战了默认的随机 unmasking 范式。
summary.technical_approach: 在 diffusion 模型之上引入一个轻量级的 policy network 来学习 unmasking 顺序。通过 policy 概率对 masked diffusion loss 中的项进行重加权，使得 policy 倾向于选择 denoiser 更有可能预测正确的位置。支持冻结 denoiser 仅训练 policy，或两者联合训练。
summary.experiments: 在对 token 顺序敏感的问题上，该方法优于常见的启发式方法。
summary.authors_note: Yoshua Bengio 团队参与的工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to learn a better unmasking (generation) order in Masked Diffusion Models compared to random or heuristic approaches?
summary_en.importance: Addresses a core pain point in discrete diffusion LMs (generation order) by proposing a learnable adaptive policy, challenging the default random unmasking paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a lightweight policy network on top of the diffusion model to learn the unmasking order. It reweights terms in the masked diffusion loss according to policy probabilities, encouraging the policy to prefer positions where the denoiser is likely correct. Supports training the policy with a frozen denoiser or joint training.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms common heuristics on problems sensitive to token order.

recommendation.zh: 关注 Discrete Diffusion LM 的生成顺序问题，用一个轻量 policy 网络去学 unmasking order，对研究非自回归/Masked LM 范式的人很有启发。
recommendation.en: Focuses on the generation order in Discrete Diffusion LMs, using a lightweight policy network to learn the unmasking order; highly inspiring for those researching non-autoregressive/Masked LM paradigms.

paper.title: BlockGen: Flexible Blockwise Sequence Modeling with Hybrid Samplers
paper.abstract: Is the uniform-state diffusion framework a more powerful paradigm for discrete diffusion? Recent studies indicate that this may be the case. In combination with predictor-corrector samplers, uniform-state diffusion models (USDMs) produce samples of higher-quality than masked diffusion models (MDMs), and USDMs equal or outperform MDMs in downstream tasks, even though they exhibit greater perplexity. Two issues remain unresolved. First, existing work compares uniform and masked diffusion with un-i

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散语言建模中两个未解决问题：(1) 现有均匀态扩散(USDM) vs 掩码扩散(MDM)的比较都是在全序列生成设置下进行的，不清楚逐块(block-by-block)生成时结论是否不变；(2) 现有比较使用的是随机重注入噪声的un-informed corrector，而非针对高错误概率token的informed corrector。
summary.importance: 对离散扩散序列建模的实际部署有直接指导意义——逐块生成配合KV缓存是提升推理吞吐量的关键路径，而informed predictor-corrector是少步采样下提升质量的重要手段。对LLM研究者的启示是：AR与扩散的混合范式（逐块AR、块内扩散）是一个值得关注的中间地带。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BlockGen——一种在混合块大小上训练的逐块序列模型，在块内同时支持掩码扩散和均匀态扩散。BlockGen具有可计算的ELBO，在AR和全序列扩散之间平滑插值。核心技术贡献还包括ARPC（AR-informed Predictor-Corrector）采样器：利用模型自身的AR预测来评分并重新生成低概率token，无需额外验证器或额外训练。
summary.experiments: 三个主要结论：(1) 混合块大小训练在OpenWebText上相比固定块大小BDM提升了perplexity；(2) 逐块设置下，祖先采样时USDM优于MDM（尤其在少步区域），与全序列趋势一致；(3) 在ARPC采样下，差距缩小并在更高NFE时反转：在GSM8K上，块大小16 (T=1)时，masked+ARPC优于uniform+ARPC，OpenWebText上的Generative Perplexity呈现同样模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Introduction中对两个开放问题的清晰陈述（5分钟），Background了解离散扩散的数学框架（10分钟），以及实验部分三个主要结论的图表（10分钟）。对LLM研究者，ARPC的设计思路（无需额外训练即可用AR预测辅助校正）是最值得借鉴的部分。无需深入公式推导细节。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供片段中确认具体机构和作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Two unresolved questions in discrete diffusion language modeling: (1) Existing comparisons between uniform-state diffusion (USDM) and masked diffusion (MDM) are all conducted under full-sequence generation settings; it is unclear whether conclusions hold when generating block-by-block. (2) Existing comparisons use un-informed correctors that reinject noise at random positions, rather than informed correctors that target tokens with high error probability.
summary_en.importance: Direct practical relevance for deploying discrete diffusion sequence models — block-by-block generation with KV-cache reuse is a key path to improve inference throughput, and informed predictor-corrector is an important technique for quality improvement under few-step sampling. For LLM researchers, the启示 is that hybrid AR-diffusion paradigms (AR across blocks, diffusion within blocks) are a promising middle ground.
summary_en.technical_approach: BlockGen is proposed — a blockwise sequence model trained over a mixture of block sizes, supporting both masked and uniform diffusion within blocks. BlockGen admits a tractable ELBO that smoothly interpolates between AR and full-sequence diffusion. A key technical contribution is ARPC (AR-informed Predictor-Corrector) sampler: it uses the model's own AR predictions to score and regenerate low-probability tokens, requiring no auxiliary verifier or extra training.
summary_en.experiments: Three main results: (1) Mixture training over block sizes improves perplexity over fixed-block BDMs on OpenWebText; (2) In the block-by-block setting with ancestral sampling, USDMs outperform MDMs (especially in the few-step regime), consistent with the full-sequence trend; (3) Under ARPC sampling, the gap closes and reverses at higher NFE: on GSM8K at block size 16 (T=1), masked+ARPC outperforms uniform+ARPC, and Generative Perplexity on OpenWebText follows the same pattern.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the clear statement of the two open questions (~5 min), Background for the discrete diffusion mathematical framework (~10 min), and the experiment section for figures presenting the three main conclusions (~10 min). For LLM researchers, the ARPC design philosophy (using AR predictions to assist correction without extra training) is the most transferrable insight. Deep engagement with formula derivations is not necessary.

recommendation.zh: 非AR序列建模的重要增量工作，重点看块级训练与靶向校正器的设计，可用于内部非AR范式的 ablation 参考
recommendation.en: Important incremental work on non-autoregressive sequence modeling; focus on blockwise training and targeted corrector design for internal non-AR ablation reference

paper.title: Unsupervised Diffusion Solver for Combinatorial Optimization via Combinatorial Adjoint Matching

summary.core_problem: 解决组合优化中 diffusion neural solver 依赖大量近似最优监督解进行训练的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是离散扩散生成和随机控制训练目标的改进。任务本身不是 LLM，但 discrete diffusion、CTMC、trajectory-level optimization signal 对研究离散生成建模有少量可迁移信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the dependence of diffusion-based neural solvers for combinatorial optimization on large sets of near-optimal supervised solutions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an objective and training formulation for discrete diffusion and stochastic control. The task is not LLM-related, but CTMC-based discrete diffusion and trajectory-level optimization signals have limited transfer value for discrete generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates diffusion-based combinatorial optimization as stochastic control over Continuous-Time Markov Chains. It introduces discrete adjoint dynamics to propagate optimization signals through discrete generative trajectories. Combinatorial Adjoint Matching provides structured, low-variance trajectory-level signals without supervised optimal solutions.

Specific task scales, model sizes, training budgets, and numerical margins are not provided in the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散训练信号有一点可迁移性；读 adjoint 推导即可，CO 结果不应影响语言建模判断。
recommendation.en: The discrete-diffusion training signal has limited transfer value; read the adjoint derivation, not the CO leaderboard numbers.

summary.core_problem: 治疗性mRNA设计需要在全长转录本上协同优化多个相互作用的序列特征（密码子使用、UTR、耦合），以同时提升稳定性、翻译效率和蛋白表达。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出将masked离散扩散模型与MCTS引导结合用于多目标mRNA序列联合生成，替代以往分段设计再组装的策略。
summary.technical_approach: mRNAutilus框架：在百万级全长mRNA上训练masked离散扩散模型，结合Monte Carlo Tree Guidance做多目标引导，用模型embedding上的轻量回归器预测半衰期/翻译效率/蛋白丰度，端到端生成完整转录本。

summary_en.core_problem: Therapeutic mRNA design requires jointly optimizing multiple interacting sequence features (codon usage, UTRs, coupling) across the full transcript to improve stability, translation efficiency, and protein expression simultaneously.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first framework combining masked discrete diffusion with MCTS guidance for multi-objective end-to-end mRNA sequence generation, replacing prior stagewise design-then-assemble strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: mRNAutilus: trains a masked discrete diffusion model on millions of full-length mRNAs, uses Monte Carlo Tree Guidance for multi-objective steering, lightweight regressors on model embeddings to predict half-life/TE/protein abundance, generating complete transcripts end-to-end.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across diverse target proteins, achieves Pareto-superior sequences vs. piecewise design + post-hoc screening baselines; model size and exact dataset scale not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为离散扩散+引导搜索在生物分子设计的应用可以了解，但对LLM预训练无直接启示；不读正文。
recommendation.en: Interesting as an application of discrete diffusion + guided search to biomolecule design, but no direct relevance to LLM pretraining; skip the full text.

paper.title: From Scores to Gibbs Correctors: Accelerating Uniform-Rate Discrete Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models have achieved strong empirical performance in text and other symbolic domains, but, especially for uniform-rate models, they often require many steps to generate a single sample. Existing acceleration methods either rely on training additional quantities or suffer from slow mixing. In this work, we propose a novel Gibbs-based corrector for discrete diffusion models, termed Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion (GADD). GADD leverages the structure of the concrete score fu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 uniform-rate 离散扩散模型的采样效率问题。相比 masked/absorbing diffusion，uniform-rate 模型没有“被 mask 后就不再变化”的单调结构，因此很难像 MDM 那样设计少步数、结构化的快速采样器。现有 uniform-rate 离散扩散加速方法大多仍停留在多项式级别的精度复杂度，也就是为了把总变差误差压到 ε，需要 O(poly(ε^{-1})) 级别的步数或函数评估。论文提出的问题很明确：能否把 uniform-rate discrete diffusion 的采样复杂度从多项式依赖降到 polylog(ε^{-1})。这不是单纯做一个更快的启发式 sampler，而是试图在理论上突破现有复杂度上界，同时保持方法只依赖标准 score estimator，不额外训练辅助网络。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性有限，因为论文主要面向离散扩散生成的一般框架，实验也包含图、音乐和 zero-shot 文本采样，而不是大规模语言预训练本身。但它对“非 AR 语言建模范式”仍有方法论价值，尤其是离散 diffusion LM 的推断效率问题。过去 diffusion LM 常被质疑的一点就是采样步数太多，哪怕训练目标有优势，推理成本也难和 AR 竞争。GADD 的意义在于给 uniform-rate 离散扩散提供了一个新的加速方向：不靠额外蒸馏，不靠重新训练 corrector，而是直接从已有 concrete score 构造 Gibbs posterior likelihood，再用 predictor-corrector 框架把扩散的 warm start 和 Gibbs 混合结合起来。贡献量级更偏理论与算法层面。如果后续能在大词表文本 diffusion LM 上稳定落地，它会影响人们如何看待离散 diffusion 作为语言建模替代范式的可行性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion，简称 GADD。它属于 predictor-corrector 采样框架，但与已有 corrector 最大的区别是：corrector 不需要额外训练，而是直接利用 uniform-rate 离散扩散里已有的 concrete score function 构造 Gibbs 更新所需的后验似然。

从机制上看，论文先保留 diffusion sampler 的 predictor 部分，用它把样本从高噪声状态逐步带到目标分布附近。然后在每个阶段或若干阶段插入 Gibbs-based corrector，对离散坐标做条件更新。关键观察是，在 uniform-rate 模型里，score estimator 已经编码了局部条件结构，足以恢复 Gibbs 更新所需的相对后验量，因此不必像一些 predictor-corrector 方法那样再训练额外的能量函数、校正器或辅助网络。

论文的理论部分给出一个比较完整的误差分解框架。总误差被拆成三部分：初始化误差、corrector 的 mixing 误差、以及 score estimation 误差。作者的论证重点不只是“Gibbs 会混得更快”，而是 diffusion predictor 提供了一个 warm start，使得 corrector 不需要从远离目标分布的位置开始混合；同时，这个 warm start 还能减轻 score 估计误差在后续步骤中的放大。基于这个结构，论文给出 GADD 的整体采样复杂度为 O(polylog(ε^{-1}))。这点是全文最核心的理论主张。

与已有方法相比，差异主要有三层。第一，和 exact simulation、τ-leaping、Euler/Tweedie 这类数值离散化方法不同，GADD 不是单纯提高 reverse process 的时间离散精度，而是显式引入 MCMC corrector。第二，和 masked diffusion 上依赖吸收态结构的快速采样不同，GADD 面向的是没有单调 unmasking 结构的 uniform-rate 模型。第三，和需要额外训练 corrector 的方法不同，它强调“零额外训练”，只复用标准 score network。这个设计对大模型尤其重要，因为如果加速方法本身还要再训练一套网络，实际采用门槛会很高。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖了 synthetic data、zero-shot unconditional text sampling 和 zero-shot conditional music generation，目的是同时验证理论复杂度、实际样本质量和 wall-clock 效率。

从论文引言和表 1 可以先读出一个重要背景：此前 uniform-rate 离散扩散采样器的复杂度上界基本都是多项式级别。比如 exact 和部分 τ-leaping 方法是 O(1/ε) 量级，Euler/Tweedie τ-leaping 常见到 O(1/ε^2)，一些 DMPM 变体甚至更差。GADD 声称达到 O(polylog(ε^{-1}))，这是它最关键的理论结果。

实证上，作者强调三点。第一，在相同 NFE 预算下，GADD 一致提升样本质量，说明它不是靠增加每步计算把收益“买”出来，而是在固定函数评估预算内更有效。第二，在尖峰型、难混合的目标分布上表现更稳，这与 Gibbs corrector 的设计目标一致，因为这类分布往往是纯 predictor 方法最容易失真的地方。第三，在现实离散生成任务上 wall-clock 也有优势，说明额外的 Gibbs 更新没有把理论收益完全吃掉。

由于当前提供的全文片段主要是引言，没有保留后文的具体表格数字、数据集规模和模型规模，无法安全复述精确数值。但从实验设置可以判断，作者并没有只做玩具验证，而是至少把方法放到了文本和音乐这两类序列生成任务上。对读者来说，更值得关注的是：GADD 的收益是否主要出现在低 NFE 区间；corrector 步数如何影响质量/时间折中；在 score 估计不够准时，理论上的 warm-start 优势是否仍然成立。这些通常会体现在消融实验里。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着“离散 diffusion 能否真正加速到可用”这个问题去读。

先看 Introduction 和 Table 1。这里把 uniform-rate 与 masked diffusion 的差异、现有复杂度上界、以及论文要突破的目标讲得很清楚。若只想判断是否值得深入，读到这里基本就够了。

然后重点看方法部分里 Gibbs posterior likelihood 如何从 concrete score 直接构造出来。这是整篇工作的算法支点。阅读时要特别确认：构造依赖哪些假设；为什么不需要额外训练；Gibbs 更新是逐坐标、分块还是别的形式；每步 corrector 的计算代价有多大。

理论部分建议认真看误差分解和主定理。关键不是记住证明细节，而是理解 polylog(ε^{-1}) 依赖成立的条件，以及这些条件在大词表文本建模里是否现实。很多理论加速方法最后卡在常数项或混合假设上，这里要格外留意。

实验部分优先看三类图：固定 NFE 下的质量对比、不同 corrector 强度的消融、以及 wall-clock 对比。如果时间有限，30 分钟可以抓住主线；若你在做 diffusion LM 采样器，建议再花 30–45 分钟细读理论和附录。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the sampling-efficiency bottleneck of uniform-rate discrete diffusion models. Unlike masked or absorbing-state diffusion, uniform-rate models do not have a monotone unmasking structure that can be exploited for fast generation. As a result, existing samplers for this class typically retain polynomial dependence on the target accuracy ε. The paper asks a sharp question: can one break the O(poly(ε^{-1})) barrier and obtain O(polylog(ε^{-1})) sampling complexity for uniform-rate discrete diffusion? The goal is not merely to propose a faster heuristic sampler, but to improve the theoretical complexity class while using only the standard score estimator, without training extra correction networks.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to mainstream LLM pretraining is limited, since the work is framed around discrete diffusion more broadly and the experiments are not centered on large-scale language pretraining. Still, it matters for alternative language-modeling paradigms, especially diffusion-based text generation. One of the persistent objections to diffusion LMs is inference cost: even when the training objective is attractive, generation often remains too slow relative to autoregressive decoding. This paper contributes a new acceleration route for uniform-rate discrete diffusion: instead of distillation or auxiliary training, it derives a Gibbs-style corrector directly from the existing concrete score function and combines it with diffusion-based warm starts. The contribution is therefore algorithmic and theoretical. If the approach scales to large-vocabulary text diffusion models, it could change how seriously uniform-rate discrete diffusion is considered as a practical non-AR modeling option.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method is Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion (GADD), a predictor-corrector sampler tailored to uniform-rate discrete diffusion models. Its defining feature is that the corrector requires no additional training. Instead, it uses the structure of the already-trained concrete score function to construct the posterior quantities needed for Gibbs updates.

Operationally, GADD keeps a diffusion-style predictor that moves the sample from a high-noise state toward the target distribution. It then inserts a Gibbs-based corrector that updates discrete coordinates conditionally. The key observation is that the score estimator already contains enough local information to recover the relative posterior likelihoods needed for Gibbs sampling. This avoids the need for separately trained energy models, auxiliary correctors, or learned refinement networks.

A major part of the paper is the error-analysis framework. The total error is decomposed into initialization error, mixing error from the corrector, and score-estimation error. The argument is not simply that Gibbs mixes faster in isolation. Rather, the diffusion process provides a warm start, so the corrector does not need to mix from a poor initialization; at the same time, this warm start also reduces the impact of score-estimation error. Under this structure, the paper proves an overall sampling complexity of O(polylog(ε^{-1})). That is the central theoretical claim.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. Compared with exact simulation, τ-leaping, Euler, or Tweedie-style discretizations, GADD is not just a better numerical integrator for the reverse process; it explicitly introduces an MCMC corrector. Compared with fast samplers for masked diffusion, it does not rely on absorbing-state structure. Compared with methods that train additional correctors, it is training-free beyond the standard score model, which is an important practical property for large models.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover synthetic distributions, zero-shot unconditional text sampling, and zero-shot conditional music generation. The goal is to validate not only the theory, but also practical sample quality and wall-clock behavior.

The background comparison in Table 1 is already informative. Prior complexity bounds for uniform-rate discrete diffusion samplers are polynomial in ε^{-1}: exact simulation and some τ-leaping variants are on the order of O(1/ε), Euler and Tweedie τ-leaping often reach O(1/ε^2), and some DMPM-style methods are worse. GADD claims O(polylog(ε^{-1})), which is the main theoretical advance.

Empirically, the paper emphasizes three findings. First, at the same NFE budget, GADD consistently improves sample quality, suggesting that the gains are not simply purchased by more expensive per-step computation. Second, it performs well on spiky and hard-to-mix target distributions, which is exactly where pure predictor methods tend to struggle. Third, it shows favorable wall-clock efficiency in realistic discrete-generation settings, meaning the extra Gibbs updates do not erase the practical benefit.

The provided full-content excerpt mainly includes the introduction, so the exact numerical results, model sizes, and dataset details are not visible here. Still, the experimental scope is broader than a toy demonstration, since the method is tested on both text and music generation. For a careful read, the most important questions are whether the gains concentrate in the low-NFE regime, how the number of corrector steps affects the quality/time trade-off, and how robust the method is when the score model is imperfect.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper with one question in mind: can discrete diffusion be accelerated enough to become a serious alternative at inference time?

Start with the introduction and Table 1. They clearly lay out the distinction between masked and uniform-rate diffusion, the current complexity landscape, and the exact barrier the paper is trying to break.

Then focus on the section that derives Gibbs posterior likelihoods from the concrete score. That is the algorithmic hinge of the paper. Check carefully what assumptions are needed, why no extra training is required, whether the Gibbs updates are coordinate-wise or blocked, and what the per-step computational overhead looks like.

The theory section deserves real attention. The important part is not every proof detail, but the conditions under which the polylog(ε^{-1}) dependence holds. For language modeling, the practical question is whether those conditions remain plausible in large-vocabulary settings, or whether the constants and mixing assumptions become the real bottleneck.

In the experiments, prioritize plots that compare quality at fixed NFE, ablations on corrector strength, and wall-clock comparisons. A first pass takes about 30 minutes. If you are actively working on diffusion LM samplers, spend another 30–45 minutes on the theory and appendix.

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散模型在文本和图像生成中表现出色，但推理速度慢，且采样效率与样本质量之间存在内在权衡。现有对这种权衡的理解大多是启发式的——masking 型转移被认为易受误差累积影响，而高度随机的均匀转移被认为具有自校正行为，但缺乏对随机性在误差传播中作用的系统性分析。
summary.importance: 从信息论角度揭示了离散扩散中随机性的误差校正机制：冗余转移通过对称交换状态间的概率质量来收缩 KL 散度意义上的采样误差。这为理解离散扩散的采样速度-质量权衡提供了原则性解释，也为设计更高效的采样算法提供了理论依据。对从事扩散语言模型（diffusion LM）研究的预训练研究员有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 首先系统刻画了马尔可夫转移中随机程度如何控制采样速度-质量权衡：高度确定性的转移收敛快但误差累积严重，更随机的转移收敛慢但最终样本质量更高。核心发现是冗余转移（redundant transitions）诱导的误差校正机制——这些转移对称交换状态对之间的概率质量而不改变时间边缘分布，可证明能收缩 KL 散度中的采样误差。基于此提出 Discrete Churn and Restart Sampling（DCRS），一种无需训练的推理算法，通过两种机制受控地注入随机性：(1) churning：执行局部前向-后向扰动；(2) restarting：使用前向转移周期性重置采样轨迹。restart 步骤通过前向过程引入随机性，无需额外的神经网络评估，可实现高效的全局误差校正。
summary.experiments: 在大规模图像和语言数据集上训练的离散扩散模型上评估 DCRS。在图像基准上，DCRS 在低 NFE（函数评估次数）情况下显著改善了速度-质量权衡，用少得多的采样步骤达到了可比的样本质量。在语言任务上观察到更细微的行为，表明误差校正随机性的强度可能依赖于领域和采样过程中的偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion models achieve strong performance in text and image generation but suffer from slow inference, with an inherent tradeoff between sampling efficiency and sample quality. Existing understanding of this tradeoff is largely heuristic — masking-based transitions are thought to be susceptible to error accumulation, while highly stochastic uniform transitions are believed to exhibit self-correcting behavior, but a systematic analysis of the role of stochasticity in error propagation is lacking.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the error-correcting mechanism of stochasticity in discrete diffusion from an information-theoretic perspective: redundant transitions symmetrically exchange probability mass between state pairs and can provably contract sampling errors in KL divergence. This provides a principled explanation for the speed-quality tradeoff in discrete diffusion sampling and theoretical guidance for designing more efficient sampling algorithms. Directly relevant to pretraining researchers working on diffusion language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: First systematically characterizes how the degree of stochasticity in Markov transitions governs the sampling speed-quality tradeoff: highly deterministic transitions converge rapidly but suffer from error accumulation, while more stochastic transitions converge more slowly to higher final sample quality. The core insight is an error-correcting mechanism induced by redundant transitions — these symmetrically exchange probability mass between state pairs without altering time marginal distributions, and can provably contract sampling errors in KL divergence. Based on this, Discrete Churn and Restart Sampling (DCRS) is proposed, a training-free inference algorithm that injects stochasticity in a controlled manner via two mechanisms: (1) churning: performing local forward-reverse perturbations; (2) restarting: periodically resetting the sampling trajectory using forward transitions. Restart steps introduce stochasticity through the forward process without additional neural network evaluations, enabling efficient global error correction across the trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: DCRS is evaluated on discrete diffusion models trained on large-scale image and language datasets. On image benchmarks, DCRS substantially improves the speed-quality tradeoff in the low-NFE regime, achieving comparable sample quality with significantly fewer sampling steps. On language tasks, more nuanced behavior is observed, indicating that the strength of error-correcting stochasticity may depend on the domain and biases in the sampling procedure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (background on continuous-time discrete diffusion), Section 3 (theoretical analysis of stochasticity and error correction), and Section 4 (DCRS algorithm). Pay attention to Figure 1 for illustrations of the core mechanism and algorithm, and Section 5 for experimental results. Worth digging deeper into: the information-theoretic analysis details (theorem proofs) of redundant transitions, the differential impact of churning vs. restarting parameter choices across modalities, and comparisons between DCRS and other accelerated sampling methods (e.g., DPM-Solver variants).

paper.title: Uniform Diffusion Models Revisited: Leave-One-Out Denoiser and Absorbing State Reformulation
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models are often trained through clean-data prediction, but the prediction can be used in different ways to define the reverse dynamics. In Masked Diffusion Models (MDM) these choices largely coincide, whereas in Uniform Diffusion Models (UDM) they do not. We show that the standard plug-in bridge parameterization for UDM is not optimized by the denoising posterior, but by a leave-one-out posterior that predicts each clean token without using its own noisy observation. This ide

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 Uniform Diffusion Model 中一个容易被忽略的目标错配问题：网络预测 clean token 后，到底应该把它解释为普通 denoising posterior、score，还是 plug-in bridge 里的 clean-token proxy。作者指出，在 UDM 里，标准 plug-in bridge 的 ELBO 最优解不是常用的 denoising posterior，而是 leave-one-out posterior，即预测第 ℓ 个 clean token 时不能使用该位置自身的 noisy observation，只能用其他位置的 noisy tokens。
summary.importance: 对离散 diffusion LM 的意义比较明确：它把 UDM 表现不如 MDM 的一部分原因从“噪声边缘分布不合适”转移到“参数化和训练目标不匹配”。这对预训练研究有启发，因为语言 diffusion 模型的 scaling 往往会被目标细节放大影响。若 clean-data prediction 的语义不清，训练 loss 看似一样，反向转移实际学到的对象会不同。作者给出的 denoiser、leave-one-out posterior、score 之间的精确转换，也让已有 UDM/MDM 系统可以在不重训或少改训练代码的情况下测试不同采样和参数化选择。
summary.technical_approach: 核心技术分三层。第一层是重新推导 UDM 的 reverse bridge。对 masked diffusion，mask token 会把当前位置是否被污染的信息显式暴露出来，因此 denoiser 和 plug-in bridge 的差异不明显；但 uniform corruption 会把 token 替换成词表内任意 token，当前位置的 noisy token 本身携带了会造成偏置的信息。作者证明，如果把网络输出直接 plug into bridge，ELBO 优化到的不是 p(x0|xt)，而是对每个位置去掉自身观测后的 p(x0_ℓ|xt_-ℓ)。第二层是给出 denoiser、leave-one-out posterior、score 的相互转换公式。这样可以把“训练目标”和“反向过程参数化”拆开：可以用 ELBO 训练 denoiser，也可以用 cross-entropy 训练 leave-one-out predictor。第三层是提出两个 absorbing-state 版本的 UDM：AUDM 和 MUDM。它们保留 UDM 的联合分布，同时引入类似 MDM 的结构便利。MUDM 可以复用 MDM denoiser 来得到 UDM joint law；AUDM 则让 UDM 在困惑度和生成质量上接近 masked diffusion。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖语言建模和较小规模的 Sudoku 任务。关键结论不是单个指标，而是一组一致性现象：在不同训练目标和 sampler 设置下，leave-one-out 参数化通常优于直接 denoiser 参数化；把 top-p 或 temperature 这类采样启发式作用在 leave-one-out predictor 上，比直接作用在 denoiser 上更合适；通过转换公式，可以让已训练 denoiser 支持 informed predictor-corrector sampler，而不需要额外训练辅助模型。作者还比较了 uniform 与 masked 过程的差距，发现 AUDM 的困惑度和生成质量与 masked diffusion 接近，说明 MDM 的优势很大程度来自参数化和采样设计，而不只是 masked marginal 本身。具体数值需要看实验表格中的 PPL、NLL、生成质量指标以及 Sudoku 成功率；摘要材料没有给出完整数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看三处：第一，理论部分中 plug-in ELBO 最优解为何变成 leave-one-out posterior 的推导，这是全文的核心；第二，denoiser、leave-one-out posterior、score 的转换公式，这部分直接影响实现；第三，AUDM/MUDM 的构造和对应实验表格，用来判断 UDM 与 MDM 差距到底来自噪声过程还是参数化。若只关心语言 diffusion LM 的训练 recipe，可以跳过部分符号细节，重点看参数化选择、sampler 设计、top-p/temperature 应用位置的实验对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a subtle objective mismatch in Uniform Diffusion Models. When a network predicts clean tokens, its output can be used as a denoising posterior, a score, or a clean-token proxy plugged into the reverse bridge. For UDMs, the plug-in bridge ELBO is not optimized by the usual denoising posterior. Its optimum is a leave-one-out posterior: to predict the clean token at position ℓ, the model should not use the noisy observation at the same position, only the noisy observations at the other positions.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the clarification of what a discrete diffusion LM is actually learning under different parameterizations. The empirical gap between uniform and masked diffusion has often been attributed to the corruption marginal itself. This work argues that a substantial part of the gap comes from the pairing of parameterization, loss, and sampler. That matters for scaling diffusion LMs, because small inconsistencies in the training target can become costly at large vocabulary size and long sequence length. The exact conversions among denoisers, leave-one-out posteriors, and scores also provide a practical way to retrofit existing systems without training a separate model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical contribution has three parts. First, the authors rederive the UDM reverse bridge and show why the plug-in bridge parameterization targets a leave-one-out posterior rather than p(x0|xt). This issue is mostly hidden in masked diffusion, where the mask symbol makes the relevant conditioning structure simpler. In uniform corruption, the current noisy token is itself a vocabulary token, so using it directly in the clean-token proxy changes the optimal predictor. Second, the paper derives exact conversion rules between the denoising posterior, the leave-one-out posterior, and the score. This separates the choice of training objective from the choice of reverse-process parameterization: a denoiser can be trained with an ELBO-style objective, and a leave-one-out predictor can be trained with cross-entropy. Third, the authors introduce two absorbing-state reformulations, AUDM and MUDM. They preserve the UDM joint law while importing structural simplifications usually associated with masked diffusion. MUDM can reuse an MDM denoiser to obtain a UDM joint process, while AUDM reaches performance close to masked diffusion.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include language modeling at larger scale and a smaller Sudoku setting. The robust finding is that the leave-one-out parameterization improves generation across objectives and samplers compared with its denoiser counterpart. The conversion formulas are also useful at inference time: a trained denoiser can be converted into the leave-one-out quantities needed by an informed predictor-corrector sampler, without an auxiliary model. Sampling heuristics such as top-p and temperature work better when applied to the leave-one-out predictor rather than directly to the denoiser. The absorbing-state variants further show that AUDM can match masked diffusion in perplexity and generation quality. The supplied text does not expose the full numeric tables, so exact values for PPL, NLL, generation metrics, and Sudoku success rates should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 30–45 minutes. The most important part is the derivation showing that the plug-in ELBO optimum is the leave-one-out posterior. The second priority is the set of conversion formulas among denoiser, leave-one-out posterior, and score, since these are directly implementable. The third priority is the AUDM/MUDM construction and the ablation tables comparing uniform, masked, and absorbing-state variants. Readers interested mainly in diffusion LM training recipes can skim the heavier notation and focus on parameterization choice, sampler design, and where top-p or temperature should be applied.

paper.title: Drifting Objectives for Refining Discrete Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (DDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising categorical token sequences, while recent drifting methods for continuous generators suggest that part of this sampling-time correction can instead be absorbed into training through an anti-symmetric fixed-point objective. We study how to transfer this principle to DDLMs, where the main challenge is the interface with discrete text: hard token samples are non-differentiable, and categorical predictions do not direc

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散语言模型（DDLM）在固定推理步数（NFE）下的样本质量很大程度由“采样时的迭代修正”决定。论文要解决的问题是：在不改采样器、不做蒸馏、保持同样NFE预算的前提下，能否把一部分采样时的修正“吸收进训练目标”，直接把现有DDLM继续训练成在同一采样流程下更会生成的模型。难点在于漂移（drifting）类固定点目标原本依赖连续样本/特征的可加性与可微性，而DDLM输出的是离散token的类别分布，硬采样会切断梯度，概率分布又不天然对应可漂移的连续点。
summary.importance: 贡献类型更像“训练目标层面的采样质量对齐”：把连续生成模型里用于提升有限步采样质量的anti-symmetric fixed-point drifting思想，改造成适用于离散文本扩散的可训练目标。对预训练研究的直接价值在于两点：第一，它提供了一条不同于改schedule/改sampler/做distill的路径，用继续训练（continual training）就能提升固定NFE的生成质量；第二，它强调了离散生成里“保留不确定性”的重要性——用soft-token在语义特征空间里表达分布，比straight-through硬token近似更稳定，提示后续做diffusion LM/any-order LM时，训练信号的连续桥接方式会显著影响训练动态与最终样本质量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫TokenDrift，核心是把连续漂移的三件事——(1)在某个空间里定义样本表示，(2)估计吸引-排斥的漂移场V(y; P_data, P_theta)，(3)用stop-gradient的“漂移后目标”做固定点训练——搬到DDLM上，并解决“离散→连续”的接口。

1) Soft-token lift（离散到连续的可微桥）：DDLM在每个位置输出类别分布p_{theta,t}。TokenDrift不对token做硬采样，而是用分布的期望embedding（expected token embeddings）构造连续输入：把词表embedding矩阵E与p做加权求和，得到每个位置的soft embedding，再送入一个冻结的语义编码器（frozen semantic encoder）得到特征y。这样漂移损失对y的梯度可以反传到logits。

2) Frozen semantic space里做anti-symmetric drifting：在特征空间估计“吸引到数据邻域、排斥模型邻域”的漂移方向，保持anti-symmetry（交换P_data与P_theta漂移方向反转），从而在P_theta=P_data时漂移信号为0，具备固定点性质，避免把模型推离数据分布的系统性偏置。

3) Stop-gradient feature target：沿漂移方向得到漂移后的特征目标y*，对y* stop-gradient，然后训练DDLM去匹配y*（直接在特征空间做回归/匹配）。论文也讨论了几种把漂移信号接回离散生成器的替代设计：例如把漂移转成logit-space的“镜像teacher”（mirror teacher）或与原始去噪/似然目标混合。作者在同预算对比后给出结论：直接feature-space drifting在“质量-熵/多样性”的权衡上更稳定。

4) 关键设计判断：soft-token lift是必要条件。用hard straight-through token surrogate会显著劣化生成质量，说明在语义特征空间里保留预测不确定性（分布形状）对漂移学习很关键；否则漂移场估计与梯度都会变得噪声大且偏置强。
summary.experiments:
论文做的是“受控的继续训练（continual-training）”设定：在OpenWebText（OWT）上，从已有DDLM出发，用TokenDrift继续训练，对比两类基线：
- 继续用原始DDLM训练目标做ordinary continuation training；
- 不同DDLM骨干：masked diffusion LM（MDLM）与uniform-state离散扩散（DUO）。

主要结论是：在固定NFE的生成评估下，TokenDrift相对MDLM基线与普通继续训练都有显著提升；并且在DUO上也能复现，说明不是特定于masked diffusion的技巧。

消融与对比重点：
- 目标形式对比：直接feature-space drifting vs logit-space mirror teacher vs 与原始去噪损失的不同混合方式；作者报告直接feature-space drifting在稳定性与质量/熵权衡上更好。
- 离散桥接对比：soft-token lift vs straight-through硬token近似；后者明显变差，支持“保留不确定性”的机制解释。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion language models (DDLMs) often rely on iterative sampling-time corrections to reach good quality, so generation quality at a fixed number of denoising steps (NFE) is not solely determined by the denoiser’s likelihood objective. The paper asks whether part of that sampling-time correction can be moved into training—refining an existing DDLM so that the same sampler, with the same NFE budget, produces better text. The key obstacle is the discrete interface: DDLMs output categorical distributions; hard token sampling is non-differentiable, and probability vectors do not naturally support the additive “drift” updates used in continuous drifting objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-objective contribution for diffusion LMs: it adapts anti-symmetric fixed-point drifting (previously used for continuous generators) to discrete text diffusion, enabling “refinement by continued training” rather than changing schedules/samplers or distilling a low-step student. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is the interface design: lifting categorical predictions into a continuous semantic feature space while preserving uncertainty is not a minor implementation detail—it materially affects gradient quality, stability, and the quality–entropy trade-off under fixed-step generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TokenDrift keeps the DDLM architecture and sampler fixed and adds a drifting-style refinement loss.

1) Differentiable lift from categorical outputs to continuous features: instead of sampling hard tokens, it computes expected token embeddings from the model’s per-position categorical distributions (soft-token embeddings). These are fed into a frozen semantic encoder to obtain continuous features.

2) Drifting in a frozen semantic space: in that feature space, it estimates an attraction–repulsion drift field V(y; P_data, P_theta), designed to be anti-symmetric so the signal vanishes at equilibrium (when model and data match). This preserves the fixed-point property that motivates drifting.

3) Stop-gradient drift target: it forms a drifted feature target y* (stop-gradient) and trains the DDLM to match y* (direct feature-space matching). The paper also explores alternative couplings—e.g., converting drift into a logit-space “mirror teacher”, and mixing with the original denoising loss—and reports that direct feature-space drifting yields the most stable balance between sample quality and entropy.

4) Why soft-token matters: replacing the soft lift with a hard straight-through surrogate significantly degrades generation, supporting the claim that preserving predictive uncertainty in the semantic space is crucial for effective drift learning.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is framed as controlled continued training on OpenWebText (OWT): starting from pretrained DDLMs, refine them with TokenDrift and compare against ordinary continuation training under the original objective. The method is tested on both a masked diffusion LM backbone (MDLM) and a uniform-state discrete diffusion backbone (DUO), and improvements under fixed-NFE generation are reported for both—suggesting the effect is not specific to masked corruption.

Key ablations include: (i) feature-space drifting vs logit-space mirror-teacher variants vs different mixtures with the denoising loss, and (ii) soft-token lift vs straight-through hard-token approximations, where the latter performs notably worse.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (NFE values, metric names, parameter/data scale, absolute gains), so exact figures cannot be quoted reliably here; they should be pulled directly from the main results and ablation tables during reading.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Focus areas for a careful read:
- The exact loss construction: how logits → soft-token embeddings → frozen encoder features → drift field → stop-grad target is implemented, and where gradients are allowed to flow.
- The design-space comparison (the section that matches budgets across variants): this is where the paper justifies feature-space matching over mirror-teacher/logit-space alternatives, and discusses stability and entropy effects.
- The soft vs straight-through ablation: it provides the clearest mechanistic evidence that uncertainty preservation matters.
- Cross-backbone results (MDLM and DUO): this supports the claim that TokenDrift is a general refinement objective for DDLMs.

Open questions worth probing: sensitivity to the choice of frozen encoder/feature layer, scalability and compute of drift estimation (nearest neighbors / kernels), and whether scheduling/annealing the drift weight improves the likelihood–quality trade-off.

We argue that this rigid partition wastes structure already present in the sequence: blocks defined by position rather than by content separate semantically coherent tokens and group unrelated ones together. summary.core_problem: 解决 block discrete diffusion language model 使用固定位置块时割裂语义结构、降低去噪建模效率的问题。
summary.importance: 这是新型语言建模范式里的架构改动：把 diffusion LM 的分块因子化从固定位置块改成内容定义的语义 chunk。它直接触及非 AR LM 的似然因子化、并行去噪和条件依赖结构。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Model。核心是 Chunking Attention：一个可微层把 token 路由到由可学习子空间参数化的 K 个 cluster，并由 diffusion 目标端到端塑形。cluster assignment 生成 chunk-causal attention mask，使离散 diffusion denoiser 按语义 chunk 自回归地分解序列似然；固定 block 是该方法的特例。

summary_en.importance: This is an architecture-level proposal for a non-autoregressive language modeling paradigm. It changes how diffusion LMs factorize likelihood, balance parallel denoising, and condition across sequence segments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Model replaces positional blocks with content-defined semantic chunks. Its key component is Chunking Attention, a differentiable layer that routes tokens into K clusters parameterized by learnable subspaces and shaped end-to-end by the diffusion objective. The assignments induce a chunk-causal attention mask under which a discrete diffusion denoiser factorizes sequence likelihood autoregressively over semantic chunks.

The important check is whether comparisons against fixed-block diffusion are matched for token budget, denoising steps, and compute.
