paper.title: Support Before Frequency in Discrete Diffusion
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models are increasingly competitive for language modeling, yet it remains unclear how their denoising objectives organize learning. Although these objectives target the full data distribution, we show that the exact reverse process induces a hierarchy between coarse support information and finer frequency information. For uniform and absorbing (a.k.a. masking) diffusion, we prove that, in the small-noise regime of the final denoising steps, each single-token reverse edit decom

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散语言模型（DLM）作为自回归语言模型的替代方案发展迅速，但现有研究对其去噪目标的学习优先级、信息层级结构缺乏清晰的理论解释，无法明确DLM训练过程中不同类型数据特征的学习顺序。
summary.importance: 从理论层面证明了离散扩散模型的「先支持集后频率」学习规律，解释了DLM的训练动态，为DLM的训练目标设计、推理加速、性能优化提供了理论依据，同时明确了掩码扩散（吸收扩散）相比均匀扩散在支持集识别上的优势，对扩散语言建模的范式迭代有直接指导价值。
summary.technical_approach: 对离散扩散的反向核做小噪声极限分析，将单token反向编辑概率分解为两个层级：主导层级由编辑是否向数据支持集（即合法序列集合）移动决定，精细层级由支持集内部的序列相对频率决定；证明当模型学到的反向概率与真实反向概率的乘法误差在o(σ^-1/2)量级时，即可准确识别向支持集移动的编辑方向，不需要精确拟合频率信息；对比均匀扩散和掩码扩散的结构差异，证明掩码扩散下仅支持集改进的去掩码操作在小噪声区处于主导阶，非改进操作的贡献可忽略。
summary.experiments: 1. 在FineWeb数据集上训练掩码DLM，设计探测任务分离支持集定位和频率排序能力，发现支持集定位的性能增益达到峰值的时间远早于频率排序，验证了先支持集后频率的学习顺序；2. 在正则语言的合成实验上验证了掩码扩散的支持集投影特性，基于理论设计的无额外训练的推理阈值策略可有效分离主导阶的支持集改进分量。测试覆盖不同随机种子，结论稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第2节的理论推导（重点是定理2.1、2.2和推论2.1）、第3节的实验设计与结果（重点是图1的训练动态曲线），附录A的离散扩散目标等价性推导、附录B的误差示例可作为补充材料阅读；值得深挖的点包括该规律在大参数量DLM上的缩放特性、基于该规律设计的新型训练课程、针对支持集优化的推理加速策略。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are developing rapidly as an alternative to autoregressive language models, but existing research lacks clear theoretical explanations for the learning priority and information hierarchy of their denoising objectives, and cannot clarify the learning order of different types of data features during DLM training.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically proves the "support before frequency" learning rule of discrete diffusion models, explains the training dynamics of DLMs, provides theoretical basis for DLM training objective design, inference acceleration and performance optimization, and clarifies the advantage of absorbing (masking) diffusion over uniform diffusion in support set identification, which has direct guiding value for paradigm iteration of diffusion language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: It conducts small-noise limit analysis on the reverse kernel of discrete diffusion, and decomposes single-token reverse edit probability into two levels: the leading level is determined by whether the edit moves toward the data support set (the set of valid sequences), and the fine level is determined by relative frequency of sequences within the support set. It proves that when the multiplicative error between the learned reverse probability and the true reverse probability is in the order of o(σ^-1/2), the model can accurately identify edit directions moving toward the support set without precise fitting of frequency information. It also compares structural differences between uniform diffusion and masking diffusion, proving that only support-improving unmasking operations are in the leading order in the small-noise regime for masking diffusion, while contributions of non-improving operations are negligible.
summary_en.experiments: 1. Train a masked DLM on the FineWeb dataset, design probe tasks to separate support set localization and frequency ranking capabilities, and find that performance gain of support set localization reaches its peak much earlier than that of frequency ranking, verifying the support-before-frequency learning order. 2. Verify the support set projection property of masking diffusion in synthetic experiments on regular languages, the theory-guided inference threshold strategy without additional training can effectively separate leading-order support improvement components. Tests cover different random seeds and deliver stable conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read theoretical derivation in Section 2 (focus on Theorem 2.1, 2.2 and Corollary 2.1), experimental design and results in Section 3 (focus on training dynamic curves in Figure 1). The derivation of discrete diffusion objective equivalence in Appendix A and error examples in Appendix B can be read as supplementary materials. Worth exploring points include scaling properties of this rule on large-parameter DLMs, new training curricula designed based on this rule, and inference acceleration strategies optimized for support set identification.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对 diffusion LM 训练动态的 prior：先复现其 support/frequency 分离推导，再决定 masked LM 该怎么配 loss。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior on diffusion-LM learning dynamics: reproduce the support-vs-frequency derivation before tuning losses for masked diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Scaling Categorical Flow Maps
paper.abstract: Continuous diffusion and flow matching models could represent a powerful alternative to autoregressive approaches for language modelling (LM), as they unlock a host of advantages currently reserved for continuous modalities, including accelerated sampling and tilting. Recently, several works have demonstrated the possibility of generating discrete data continuously by a simple flow matching process between a Gaussian and the one-hot encoded data distribution. They have further shown the feasibil

summary.core_problem: Categorical Flow Maps (CFMs)作为一种替代AR的离散生成建模范式，此前未在十亿参数、万亿token的规模下验证可行性。核心障碍在于CFM需要对每个位置输出完整的L×|V| logit矩阵，在现代LLM词汇表可达20万的情况下，内存和计算开销巨大。
summary.importance: 这是首个将continuous flow matching范式规模化到1.7B参数、2.1T token预训练的工作，直接与masked diffusion、uniform diffusion和AR基准对比。对于探索AR之外的语言建模范式（diffusion LM、flow matching）具有里程碑意义。它证明CFM可以在同等计算下与现有非AR方法竞争，并且通过self-distillation实现更少采样步数（NFE）的高质量生成，为流式生成、可控生成和推理-time compute-quality tradeoff开辟了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: CFM将连续flow map matching框架扩展到离散情形。模型在simplex上演化token分布，通过ODE轨迹将噪声样本输运到数据分布。核心技术包括：(1) Categorical Flow Map将两时间向量场重新参数化为v_{s,t}(x) = (π_{s,t}(x) - x) / (1-s)，其中π是"部分去噪器"；(2) 切线条件（tangent condition）简化为交叉熵损失，保证模型与概率流一致；(3) 两种self-distillation损失：PSD（Progressive Self-Distillation，基于KL散度的连续时间shortcut modeling）和JSD-based变体；(4) 提供半离散ELBO用于似然评估。与离散diffusion的关键区别：CFM在连续simplex空间而非离散网格上演化，因此可以直接移植连续域的flow map工具（如few-step采样、steering、fine-tuning at inference）。
summary.experiments: 作者在400M proxy规模上做了350+组配置搜索以确定稳健超参，然后训练了1.7B参数模型在2.1T token上。关键结果：(1) Gen PPL随NFE增加而下降，在NFE≈64时接近AR水平；(2) Token entropy随NFE增加而降低并收敛到数据分布的entropy（灰色条带）；(3) Self-distillation（PSD+KL, PSD+JSD）大幅提升了少步数区域的Pareto前沿——NFE=4时即可达到不错的生成质量，而原始CFM需要NFE≈64才能达到类似PPL；(4) MCQA benchmark结果与其他非AR方法在同一区间。文中提供了不同NFE下的定性样本对比，显示低NFE（如NFE=4）时出现'the the, the,,,'等重复退化，经过self-distillation后在同等NFE下生成质量显著改善。
summary.reading_guide: 必读章节和图表：(1) Figure 1左右两图是核心结果——Gen PPL vs NFE和Token entropy vs NFE，直观展示self-distillation的效果；(2) 第1章引言清晰陈述了动机和贡献；(3) 第2章背景部分系统梳理了AR、stochastic interpolants、flow map matching和CFM的关系；(4) 第3章设计空间探索和第4章全规模实验结果；(5) 第4.3节的ELBO推导和likelihood评估方法。值得深挖的点：self-distillation如何实现continuous-time shortcut modeling（公式2.11），以及PSD vs JSD两种distillation损失的tradeoff。预计精读时间60-90分钟。
summary.authors_note: Apple团队（含一位牛津大学附属的实习生）。

summary_en.core_problem: Categorical Flow Maps (CFMs), an alternative to autoregressive language modeling, had not been validated at the billion-parameter, trillion-token scale. The core barrier is that CFMs require materializing full L×|V| logit matrices per position, which becomes prohibitive with modern LLM vocabularies reaching 200,000 tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is the first work scaling continuous flow matching to 1.7B parameters and 2.1T training tokens, with direct comparisons to masked diffusion, uniform diffusion, and AR baselines. It is a significant milestone for exploring language modeling paradigms beyond autoregressive next-token prediction. The work demonstrates that CFMs can compete with existing non-AR methods under matched compute, and that self-distillation enables high-quality generation at significantly fewer sampling steps (NFEs), opening new paths for streaming generation, controllable generation, and inference-time compute-quality tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: CFM extends the continuous flow map matching framework to the discrete case. The model evolves token distributions on the simplex, transporting noisy samples to the data distribution via ODE trajectories. Key technical components: (1) Categorical Flow Map reparameterizes the two-time vector field as v_{s,t}(x) = (π_{s,t}(x) - x) / (1-s) where π is a "partial denoiser"; (2) The tangent condition reduces to cross-entropy loss, ensuring consistency with the probability flow; (3) Two self-distillation losses: PSD (Progressive Self-Distillation, continuous-time shortcut modeling via KL divergence) and a JSD-based variant; (4) A semi-discrete ELBO for likelihood-based evaluation. Key distinction from discrete diffusion: CFMs evolve in the continuous simplex space rather than on a discrete grid, enabling direct porting of continuous-domain flow map tools (few-step sampling, steering, inference-time fine-tuning).
summary_en.experiments: The authors ran 350+ configuration searches at 400M proxy scale to identify robust hyperparameters, then trained a 1.7B-parameter model on 2.1T tokens. Key results: (1) Gen PPL decreases with NFE, approaching AR levels around NFE≈64; (2) Token entropy decreases with NFE and converges to the data distribution entropy (gray band); (3) Self-distillation (PSD+KL, PSD+JSD) substantially improves the Pareto front in the few-step regime — achieving decent generation quality at NFE=4, whereas undistilled CFM requires NFE≈64 for comparable PPL; (4) MCQA benchmark results are in the same range as other non-autoregressive methods. Qualitative samples at different NFEs show degradation (e.g., 'the the, the,,,') at low NFE for undistilled models, with significantly improved quality after self-distillation at the same NFE.
summary_en.reading_guide: Must-read sections and figures: (1) Figure 1 (both panels) — Gen PPL vs NFE and Token entropy vs NFE, the core results visualizing self-distillation benefits; (2) Section 1 for clear motivation and contributions; (3) Section 2 for systematic background on AR, stochastic interpolants, flow map matching, and CFM; (4) Section 3 design space exploration and Section 4 full-scale experiments; (5) Section 4.3 ELBO derivation and likelihood evaluation. Worth deep-diving: how self-distillation enables continuous-time shortcut modeling (Equation 2.11), and the tradeoffs between PSD vs JSD distillation losses. Estimated close reading time: 60-90 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Apple team (including one intern affiliated with the University of Oxford).

recommendation.zh: 少数把 non-AR 离散 flow LM 推到 1.7B/2.1T 的实证；应复现它的蒸馏和 entropy 诊断，别只看 4 步采样口号。
recommendation.en: One of the few non-AR discrete-flow LM scale-ups at 1.7B/2.1T; reproduce the distillation and entropy diagnostics, not just the four-step sampling claim.

paper.title: Consistent Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are an attractive alternative to autoregressive models because they promise sublinear-time, parallel generation, yet practical gains remain elusive as high-quality samples still demand hundreds of refinement steps. In continuous domains, consistency training along the probability-flow ODE is a popular recipe to accelerate diffusion. For discrete diffusion, no analogous sample-space ODE exists, making direct adaptation ill-defined. We argue that the natural discre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是离散 diffusion language model 的核心效率瓶颈。DLM 理论上可以并行生成，摆脱 AR 的逐 token 解码，但实际高质量采样往往需要上百步 refinement，速度优势被大幅抵消。连续扩散里，consistency model 可以沿 probability-flow ODE 学到少步甚至一步生成；但离散空间没有对应的样本级确定性 ODE，直接照搬 consistency training 在定义上就站不住。论文要解决的是：在离散 token 空间里，如何给 consistency 一个严格、可训练、又能真正带来 few-step generation 的形式化基础。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究，这篇工作属于新型语言建模范式，相关性很高。它的重要性不只在于把 DLM 采样步数降下来，而在于给离散 diffusion 的“快速生成”问题提供了一个更干净的理论对象：不是去硬造一个离散版 ODE，也不是依赖 teacher distillation 或连续松弛近似，而是直接利用离散 corruption process 自带的 exact posterior bridge。这个视角有两层价值。第一，它把 masked diffusion、consistency、progressive distillation、shortcut 这几条线放进同一个框架里。第二，它说明离散生成模型的加速未必需要两阶段蒸馏，训练目标本身可以直接鼓励长跳跃、少步恢复。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Multi-Path Discrete Consistency, MPDC。作者的出发点很明确：连续 consistency 依赖 PF-ODE，因为任意噪声层级之间存在唯一确定路径；离散扩散没有这种路径，所以不能要求模型在一条不存在的轨迹上点对点一致。替代方案是转向 stochastic path，也就是后验桥接分布 q(x_s | x_t, x_0)。

对很多离散 corruption family，尤其 masked diffusion 和 uniform diffusion，这个 posterior bridge 可以解析写出。给定更噪的状态 x_t 和原始样本 x_0，可以直接从 q(x_s | x_t, x_0) 采样一个更干净的中间状态 x_s，其中 s < t。这样，t 到 0 的恢复不再被理解为沿唯一轨迹演化，而是存在一族合法的随机路径：可以一步大跳，也可以多步细化，只要这些路径都对应同一个真实后验桥，它们在期望意义下应当给出一致的去噪结论。

CDLM 的训练目标就是让时间条件预测器 f_theta(x_t, t) 与 f_theta(x_s, s) 在这种 bridge coupling 下保持一致。直观上，模型被训练成满足一种路径无关性：从更噪状态直接预测，应该等价于先按真实桥接分布跳到更干净状态，再完成更容易的去噪任务。这样训练后，few-step generation 不是额外蒸馏出来的近似能力，而是 path-equivalence 的直接结果。

这和已有方法的区别很关键。标准 masked diffusion 只学局部相邻时间步的去噪，长程跳跃能力弱，所以采样步数一少就掉质量。progressive distillation、SDTT、DUO-DCD 这类方法通常需要 teacher 轨迹或多阶段蒸馏，把多步过程压缩成少步。CDLM 则是单阶段、teacher-free，从一开始就在训练目标里显式覆盖长路径和短路径的一致性。论文还强调，这个框架不局限于 masked diffusion，只要 corruption process 的 posterior bridge 可 tractable，就能套用。
summary.experiments:
实验重点是 few-step 采样质量与多样性的平衡。作者将 CDLM 与几类基线比较：从头训练的基础 DLM，如 MDLM、DUO；以及蒸馏型加速模型，如 SDTT、DUO+DCD。结论是，CDLM 作为单阶段模型，在不同采样预算下都取得了很强的结果，常常能追平甚至超过多阶段蒸馏方法，同时保持更好的样本多样性。

摘要里给出的最明确数字是：蒸馏后的 CDLM 变体相对 AR baseline 可达到最高 32× 的速度提升。这里需要注意两点。第一，作者区分了“single-stage from scratch”的 CDLM 与进一步蒸馏的 variant，前者已经能和现有 distilled discrete diffusion 方法竞争，后者则把速度再往前推。第二，论文强调的是 varied sampling budgets 下的表现，而不是只挑某一个 1-step 或 2-step 点做展示，这说明方法的收益不是偶然对齐某个固定步数。

从全文结构判断，关键实验应包括：不同采样步数下的生成质量曲线；与 MDLM/DUO 的 base-to-base 对比；与 SDTT、DUO+DCD 的 accelerated-to-accelerated 对比；以及多样性指标，证明少步生成不是靠模式坍缩换来的。若正文给出 bridge path 采样策略、时间对采样分布、以及长短路径混合训练的消融，这些部分最值得看，因为它们直接回答性能来自哪里。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住论文的理论转向：离散空间里没有 PF-ODE，所以 consistency 的对象必须从 deterministic trajectory 改成 posterior bridge family。只要这一点想清楚，后面的目标函数和实验设计都会顺很多。

建议先看 Introduction 和方法总览，确认 MPDC 的定义、为什么 q(x_s | x_t, x_0) 可解析、以及它如何把 long-hop denoising 纳入训练。然后直接看主实验图，尤其是不同 sampling budget 下与 MDLM、DUO、SDTT、DUO+DCD 的对比。如果时间还有余量，再看 unified view 那一节，作者如何把 standard diffusion、consistency、distillation、shortcut 放进同一框架，这部分对做新型 LM 范式的人很有启发。

预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若要深挖，重点看 posterior bridge 的推导、训练目标的 unbiasedness/consistency 解释，以及 few-step 质量为何没有像以往方法那样快速饱和。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the main practical bottleneck of diffusion language models: generation is parallel in principle, but high-quality text still requires hundreds of denoising steps, which erodes the speed advantage over autoregressive decoding. In continuous diffusion, consistency models solve this by enforcing invariance along the probability-flow ODE. In discrete token space, however, there is no analogous deterministic sample-space trajectory. The paper asks how to define a principled consistency objective for discrete diffusion that actually supports few-step generation.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to alternative language-modeling paradigms beyond next-token AR. Its significance is not only empirical acceleration, but a cleaner theoretical object for discrete diffusion: exact posterior bridges induced by the corruption process itself. That matters for two reasons. First, it gives a unified lens on masked diffusion, consistency training, progressive distillation, shortcut models, and recent discrete distillation methods. Second, it suggests that fast discrete generation need not rely on teacher trajectories or multi-stage compression; the training objective itself can teach long-range denoising jumps.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is Multi-Path Discrete Consistency (MPDC). In continuous space, consistency training works because any noisy state lies on a unique probability-flow trajectory toward the data manifold. In discrete space, there is no such deterministic path, so pointwise trajectory consistency is ill-defined.

The paper replaces that missing object with a stochastic one: the exact posterior bridge q(x_s | x_t, x_0) between two noise levels s < t. For broad corruption families, including masked and uniform diffusion, this bridge is available in closed form. Given a noisier state x_t and the clean sample x_0, one can sample a cleaner intermediate state x_s exactly from the bridge. This yields a family of valid stochastic paths from x_t toward x_0, ranging from direct long jumps to gradual refinements.

CDLM trains a time-conditional predictor f_theta(x_t, t) to be consistent with f_theta(x_s, s) under this bridge coupling. Intuitively, predicting from a noisy state should agree with first hopping to a cleaner state via the true posterior bridge and then solving the easier denoising problem there. Few-step generation then emerges from path equivalence rather than from post hoc distillation.

This is the main departure from prior work. Standard masked diffusion mostly learns local denoising transitions and therefore degrades quickly when the number of sampling steps is reduced. Distillation-based accelerators such as SDTT or DUO+DCD compress a many-step teacher into a short-step student, often in multiple stages. CDLM is single-stage and teacher-free: it directly trains on both short and long bridges from scratch. The framework is also presented as general beyond masked diffusion, as long as the corruption process admits a tractable posterior bridge.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on the quality-speed-diversity trade-off under limited sampling budgets. CDLM is compared against strong base DLMs trained from scratch, including MDLM and DUO, as well as accelerated or distilled systems such as SDTT and DUO+DCD. The main empirical claim is that CDLM sets the strongest results among single-stage models across a range of sampling budgets, often matching or surpassing multi-stage distilled methods while preserving better sample diversity.

The clearest quantitative statement in the paper is that a distilled CDLM variant achieves up to 32x speedup over autoregressive baselines. Importantly, the paper distinguishes between the base CDLM trained in a single stage from scratch and a further distilled variant used to push speed even further. That separation matters: the contribution is not merely another distillation recipe, but a training principle that already improves few-step generation before any teacher-student compression.

The most informative results are likely the curves over different numbers of denoising steps, base-to-base comparisons against MDLM and DUO, accelerated-to-accelerated comparisons against SDTT and DUO+DCD, and diversity metrics showing that the gains are not coming from collapse. Ablations around bridge sampling, time-pair selection, and the mix of short versus long paths are the sections most worth checking closely.
summary_en.reading_guide:
The key to reading the paper efficiently is to internalize the conceptual shift early: in discrete space there is no PF-ODE, so consistency must be defined over a family of posterior bridges rather than a deterministic trajectory. Once that is clear, the objective and the empirical design become much easier to follow.

Start with the introduction and the method overview. Focus on how MPDC is defined, why q(x_s | x_t, x_0) is tractable for masked and uniform diffusion, and how this lets the model learn long-hop denoising directly. Then go straight to the main figures comparing CDLM with MDLM, DUO, SDTT, and DUO+DCD across different sampling budgets. If you have more time, read the section that unifies standard diffusion, consistency, distillation, and shortcut methods under the bridge-consistency view; that part is especially useful for researchers thinking about non-AR language modeling.

A solid skim should take 30–45 minutes. For deeper study, focus on the posterior-bridge derivation, the exact training objective, and the evidence for why few-step quality does not saturate as quickly as in prior discrete diffusion accelerators.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看方法定义而不是 headline：若 MPDC 真把离散 consistency 立住，DLM 的主要短板会被削弱；先读公式和少步采样表，别急着信生成质量。
recommendation.en: Read this for the formulation, not the headline: if MPDC is the right discrete consistency object, it weakens the main practical objection to DLMs; inspect the equations and few-step tables before trusting the samples.

paper.title: Binomial flows: Denoising and flow matching for discrete ordinal data
paper.abstract: Flow-based generative modeling in continuous spaces exploit Tweedie's formula to express the denoiser (learned in training) as a score function (used in sampling). In contrast, this relation has been largely missing in the discrete setting where common approaches focus on learning discrete scores and rates. In this work we close this gap for discrete non-negative ordinal data by introducing Binomial flows. Our framework provides a simple recipe for training a discrete diffusion model which simul

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是离散有序数据上的一个基础缺口：连续扩散/flow matching 里，denoiser、score、sampling、likelihood 之间有一套很完整的关系，核心工具是 Tweedie 公式；但在离散空间，尤其是非负有序离散数据上，这套关系并不完整，很多方法只能直接学离散 score 或反向转移率，训练和采样都更绕。作者想做的是给离散 ordinal 数据找一个与高斯噪声相对应的 noising family，使得“学 denoiser”这条路线在离散情形下也成立，并且能导出可用的采样和似然计算公式。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，因为论文面向的是一般离散有序数据生成，不是文本语言建模，也没有讨论 tokenizer、离散序列建模或大规模预训练实践。但从新型语言建模范式的角度，它有方法论价值：一是说明离散 diffusion/flow 不一定非要围绕 score 或 rate parameterization 设计，denoiser 也可以成为一等公民；二是给“离散 Tweedie 公式”提供了一个具体可行的构造，这对未来做离散 token 生成、图像 token、音频 codec token、甚至某些 ordinal tokenizer 的统一建模有启发。贡献更偏理论与生成建模基础，不是当前 LLM pretrain pipeline 可直接落地的方案。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是引入 Binomial flows。作者的出发点很明确：在连续空间里，高斯噪声之所以特殊，不只是因为它好加噪，而是因为它让 denoiser 与 score 之间存在 Tweedie 关系，从而把训练目标和采样过程接起来。离散空间缺的正是这个桥。对于定义在非负有序空间上的数据，作者提出用 Binomial noising 作为高斯噪声的离散对应物。

具体上，论文先定义一族从干净样本 X_T 到中间时刻 X_t 的条件分布 p_{t|T}，要求满足三个标准性质：容易采样；t=T 时退化为原样本；t=0 时完全忘掉原样本。然后在这个 flow 上训练 denoiser m(t,x)=E[X_T|X_t=x]，训练目标是带时间权重的 Bregman divergence。这个部分和连续 diffusion 中“直接回归 clean target 的条件期望”是平行的。

关键创新在后面三步：
1. 证明在 Binomial noising 下，denoiser 满足离散版 Tweedie 公式，可以从 denoiser 恢复与当前扰动分布相关的 score-like quantity；
2. 利用这个关系，把采样过程写成 Poisson-Föllmer process，从纯噪声在有限时间内精确到达目标分布，而不是只给一个启发式反向链；
3. 推导出一个涉及 denoiser 的似然恒等式，因此模型不仅能生成，还能做 exact likelihood estimation 和相应训练。

这和常见离散 diffusion 的区别很明显。很多离散方法直接学习 p(x_0|x_t)、离散 score、或跳转 rate matrix，采样时依赖近似反向过程。这里作者强调的是：选对 noising family 后，denoiser 本身就足够支撑训练、采样和似然三件事，结构上更接近连续 diffusion 的统一配方。

需要注意的是，这个框架依赖“非负、有序、ordinal”结构。它不直接覆盖无序类别空间，因此离文本 token 这种 nominal discrete space 还有距离。若想迁移到 LM，需要额外的 token ordering 或分解结构，这不是论文当前解决的问题。
summary.experiments:
实验部分验证了三件事：
1. 在合成数据上，Binomial flow 的理论关系可以被数值验证，说明 denoiser→sampling→likelihood 这条链条是闭合的；
2. 在真实数据上，方法能得到有竞争力的生成质量，摘要里明确提到 imaging datasets 上取得了 competitive FID；
3. 论文不仅展示采样，还展示 exact likelihood estimation，这一点和很多只报生成质量的离散 diffusion 工作不同。

从当前提供的正文片段看，实验章节的具体数据表没有展开，因此无法准确给出数据集名称、模型规模、FID 数值、训练步数或与哪些 baseline 的具体差距。能确认的是，作者同时做了 synthetic 和 real-world datasets，两类实验分别对应理论正确性与实际生成性能。阅读时应特别看：不同 Bregman divergence 的影响、Binomial noising 参数化是否敏感、Poisson-Föllmer 采样在有限步数下的稳定性，以及 likelihood 估计是否真的可计算而不是高方差近似。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“定义—定理—实验”三步读。
1. 先看 Introduction 和 Section 2 开头，弄清作者为什么认为 Binomial 是离散 ordinal 空间里更自然的 Gaussian analogue。这里如果没看懂，后面的 Tweedie 公式就会显得像技巧堆砌。
2. 再看离散 Tweedie 公式和 Poisson-Föllmer process 的主定理。这是全文核心。重点不是逐行验算，而是理解：denoiser 如何转成可采样的对象，为什么能在有限时间精确采样，以及这个“精确”依赖哪些假设。
3. 最后看 likelihood identity 和实验。若只想判断方法是否值得继续跟，实验部分看 synthetic 验证图和真实数据主表即可。

预计阅读时间 35–50 分钟。对做离散 diffusion、图像/音频 token 生成、或非 AR 语言建模的人有方法启发；若只做标准文本 AR 预训练，可以只读引言、主定理和实验结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural gap in discrete generative modeling for ordinal data. In continuous diffusion and flow matching, denoising, score estimation, sampling, and likelihood are tied together by a clean mathematical relation centered on Tweedie’s formula. In discrete spaces, especially for non-negative ordered data, that bridge is largely missing, so many methods learn discrete scores or jump rates directly and rely on less unified sampling procedures. The goal here is to identify a noising family for discrete ordinal data that plays the role Gaussian noise plays in the continuous case, so that denoiser-based training can again support sampling and likelihood evaluation in a principled way.
summary_en.importance: The paper is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining. It is not about text language modeling, tokenizers, or large-scale pretraining practice. Its value is methodological. First, it shows that discrete diffusion and flow models do not have to be built only around score or rate parameterizations; denoisers can be the central object if the noise model is chosen correctly. Second, it provides a concrete construction of a discrete Tweedie-type relation, which could matter for future work on discrete token generation, image tokens, audio codec tokens, or other ordinal latent spaces. The contribution is more foundational for discrete generative modeling than immediately actionable for current LLM pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is to introduce Binomial flows. The motivation is precise: Gaussian noise is special in continuous diffusion not merely because it is easy to sample, but because it yields Tweedie’s formula, which connects the denoiser to the score and thereby links training to sampling. The discrete setting lacks this bridge. For data living on a non-negative ordered space, the authors propose Binomial noising as the discrete analogue of Gaussian perturbation.

They first define a family of conditional distributions p_{t|T} that maps a clean sample X_T to an intermediate noisy sample X_t, with the usual three properties: easy perturbation, identity at t=T, and complete forgetting at t=0. On top of this flow they train a denoiser m(t,x)=E[X_T|X_t=x] using a time-weighted Bregman-divergence objective. This mirrors the standard denoiser-training view in continuous diffusion.

The technical contribution then comes in three linked steps:
1. under Binomial noising, the denoiser satisfies a discrete Tweedie formula, allowing recovery of a score-like object from the denoiser;
2. this relation leads to a sampling procedure via the Poisson-Föllmer process, which reaches the target distribution exactly in finite time rather than through a purely heuristic reverse chain;
3. the authors derive a likelihood identity involving the Binomial-flow denoiser, enabling exact likelihood estimation and corresponding training.

This differs from many discrete diffusion models that directly learn p(x_0|x_t), a discrete score, or a jump-rate matrix and then sample using approximate reverse dynamics. Here the claim is stronger: with the right noising family, the denoiser alone can support training, sampling, and likelihood in a unified recipe, much closer in spirit to continuous diffusion.

An important limitation is that the framework relies on non-negative ordinal structure. It does not directly apply to unordered categorical spaces, so there is still a gap to standard text tokens, which are nominal rather than ordinal. Extending the idea to language would require additional structure that this paper does not provide.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments appear to validate three points.
1. On synthetic data, the theoretical chain from denoiser to sampling and likelihood is numerically verified, showing that the proposed construction is internally consistent.
2. On real datasets, the method achieves competitive generative performance; the abstract explicitly mentions competitive FID on imaging datasets.
3. Unlike many discrete diffusion papers that only report sample quality, this one also demonstrates exact likelihood estimation.

The provided excerpt does not include the full experimental tables, dataset names, model sizes, FID values, training budgets, or exact margins over baselines, so precise numbers should not be fabricated. What can be stated safely is that the evaluation spans both synthetic and real-world datasets, with the former supporting the theory and the latter testing practical generation quality. When reading the experiments, the most useful checks are the effect of different Bregman divergences, sensitivity to the Binomial noising parameterization, stability of Poisson-Föllmer sampling in finite time, and whether the likelihood computation is truly exact rather than a noisy approximation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order definition, theorem, experiment.
1. Start with the introduction and the opening of Section 2 to understand why the authors regard Binomial noise as the natural Gaussian analogue for discrete ordinal spaces. Without that intuition, the later Tweedie result can look arbitrary.
2. Then read the main theorem on the discrete Tweedie formula and the Poisson-Föllmer process. This is the core of the paper. The key question is not line-by-line proof checking, but understanding how the denoiser becomes a sampling object, why finite-time exact sampling is possible, and which assumptions that exactness depends on.
3. Finish with the likelihood identity and the experiments. If the goal is only to assess whether the method is worth following, the synthetic validation figures and the main real-data table are enough.

Estimated reading time is 35–50 minutes. It is more useful for readers working on discrete diffusion, image/audio token generation, or non-AR generative modeling than for readers focused on standard autoregressive text pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散语言模型（Diffusion LM）的底层理论补丁，用二项分布推导了离散 Tweedie 公式，做 SEDD/MDLM 方向的必看理论推导。
recommendation.en: A fundamental theoretical patch for discrete diffusion LMs, deriving a discrete Tweedie's formula via binomial distributions; a must-read for theoretical foundations in the SEDD/MDLM direction.

paper.title: Dream-Cubed: Controllable Generative Modeling in Minecraft by Training on Billions of Cubes

summary.core_problem: 解决 Minecraft 体素世界的可控生成问题，重点是如何在离散 block 空间上做大规模生成建模与数据构建。
summary.importance: 价值主要在三点：大规模 3D/体素数据集、离散与连续 diffusion 在 voxel 生成上的系统比较、以及面向交互式编辑的生成接口。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对离散 token 化、多模态统一建模和非文本生成范式有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 Dream-Cubed 数据集，包含程序生成地形与高质量人工地图的混合数据；提出一系列直接在 cube/block token 空间上建模的生成模型，系统比较 discrete diffusion 与 continuous diffusion 的配方、数据配比和架构设计，并支持 inpainting/outpainting 等交互式控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要称数据规模达到 tens of billions of tokens，并开展大规模 3D diffusion 研究；评测上改造 FID 以衡量真实与生成世界渲染图的语义差异，并辅以人类偏好实验。摘要未给出具体参数量、训练算力或相对提升幅度，因此更适合作为方向性参考而非结果导向阅读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 New York University。若关注“把非文本离散单元纳入统一生成建模”这一脉络，这篇工作的代表性在于 voxel/block 级 token 空间而非传统连续 3D 表示。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles controllable generation of Minecraft voxel worlds, focusing on large-scale modeling and data construction directly in discrete block space.
summary_en.importance: Its value lies in three aspects: a large-scale 3D voxel dataset, a systematic comparison of discrete vs. continuous diffusion for voxel generation, and an interface for interactive editing. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it has indirect relevance to discrete tokenization, unified multimodal modeling, and non-AR generative paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds the Dream-Cubed dataset from a curated mixture of procedural biome terrain and high-quality human-authored maps, then trains a family of models that operate directly over cube/block tokens. The study compares discrete and continuous diffusion formulations, data mixtures, and architectural choices, while supporting controllable inpainting and outpainting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states the dataset contains tens of billions of tokens and presents a large-scale study of 3D diffusion. Evaluation adapts FID to measure semantic differences between real and generated world renderings and includes human preference studies. The abstract does not provide model sizes, compute, or exact gains, so this is more useful as a directional reference than a result-driven read.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from New York University. For readers interested in bringing non-text discrete units into unified generative modeling, the representative aspect here is voxel/block token space rather than standard continuous 3D representations.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相连，但“billions of cubes + discrete diffusion”这组设定值得记账；只看数据配比和离散/连续 diffusion 对比，别在具体 3D 指标上花时间。
recommendation.en: Not directly an LLM paper, but the ‘billions of cubes + discrete diffusion’ setup is worth logging; read only the data-mixture and discrete-vs-continuous sections, not the 3D metrics.

summary.core_problem: 现有基于连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）的离散扩散模型将反向速率矩阵作为整体参数化，未匹配CTMC跳变时机和跳变方向的内在分解结构，同时均匀前向过程的生成效果普遍弱于掩码前向过程。
summary.importance: 为离散扩散建模提供了符合CTMC第一性原理的参数化思路，验证了均匀前向过程在离散生成任务上的性能潜力，可用于文本生成类预训练新范式的探索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Neural CTMC，将反向过程拆分为两个独立网络头，分别参数化跳变退出率（何时跳）和跳变分布（跳去哪）；推导得到的证据下界（ELBO）自然分解为跳变时机的泊松KL散度和跳变方向的分类KL散度，该范式可严格泛化现有基于掩码前向过程的离散扩散方法。
summary.experiments: 在TinyStories数据集上生成困惑度≤16.36，优于同设置下GIDD的≤37.60、MDLM的≤42.66；在OpenWebText数据集上，16到128采样步区间内，同等计算预算下生成困惑度优于对比的掩码基方法，是首个性能超过主流掩码基方法的纯均匀前向过程离散扩散模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第2章CTMC基础分解原理、第4.1章目标函数分解推导，以及第5章实验结果对比部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing discrete diffusion models based on continuous-time Markov chains (CTMCs) parameterize the reverse rate matrix as a monolithic object, which does not align with the intrinsic decomposition of CTMC dynamics into jump timing and jump direction. Besides, uniform forward processes generally underperform masked forward processes in discrete generation tasks.
summary_en.importance: It provides a first-principle aligned parameterization paradigm for discrete diffusion modeling, verifies the performance potential of uniform forward processes for discrete generation, and supports exploration of new pre-training paradigms for text generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Neural CTMC is proposed, which uses two separate network heads to parameterize the exit rate (when to jump) and jump distribution (where to jump) of the reverse process. The derived ELBO naturally decomposes into a Poisson KL for jump timing and a categorical KL for jump direction, and the formulation strictly generalizes existing discrete diffusion methods with masked forward processes.
summary_en.experiments: On TinyStories, it achieves generative perplexity ≤ 16.36, outperforming GIDD (≤37.60) and MDLM (≤42.66) under the same evaluation protocol. On OpenWebText, it obtains the best generative perplexity under equal compute budget across 16 to 128 sampling steps, and is the first pure uniform forward process discrete diffusion model that outperforms mainstream masked-based methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus: Chapter 2 for basic CTMC decomposition, Chapter 4.1 for objective decomposition derivation, and Chapter 5 for experimental comparison. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
